tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' 'grel tshigs su bcad pa mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ sat+ta dharma ra sai kā bhi prā ya s+ya pañci kā ga thān+dha kā ra skaṃ bh+yā lo ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' 'grel tshigs su bcad pa mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo| |gang gi thugs bskyed rmad byung rgya mtsho las// legs thon 'gro blo'i yid mkhar rtag 'char ba// don gnyis mthar phyin bdag cag gi ston pa| |thub chen smra ba'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// rnam kun mchog ldan mtha' bral shing rta'i srol// ma nyams ston la rgyal bas lung bstan pa// rgyal ba gnyis pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// nges pa'i don ston de la bdag phyag 'tshal// de nyid gangs can ljongs 'dir grub pa'i mtha'// dag dang ma dag sna tshogs gya gyu'i 'gros// drang por srong phyir rat+na shrī zhes pa// mgon po 'bri gung pa der gus phyag 'tshal| |de yi bzhed srol phyogs dus rgyal kun gyi// dgongs pa gcig tu ston pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /'grel byed mang yang rang 'dod mun pas bsgribs// de sel sgron me nyin byed kho bos sbar/ /rta bdun dbang po lang tsho ngom pa'i tshe/ /gos ser can sogs dben par gab pa bzhin| |legs bshad gdong lnga'i nga ro 'di bsgrags tshe// blo ngan lag 'gro'i tshogs rnams gcom skyungs shig / ༈ 1 /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis chos rnams ma lus pa// babs kyi gnas lugs bstan ces gsungs pa ni// thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa des// chos rnams rang rang mtshan nyid ji lta bar// ma 'khrul mkhyen cing de yang phyogs re tsam// ma yin ji snyed gzigs pas rgyu dang 'bras// rten dang de 'brel gshis sam rang gi babs// me las tsha sreg ma gtogs rlan gsher gyi// gshis sam babs med de las de mi 'byung*// dge las sdug bsngal mi dge'i las dag las// bde ba mi 'byung rgyu dang 'bras 'byung ba// dge la brten nas 'bras 'byung bde thob ste| |mi 'am ci'i rgyal ljon pas zhus pa'i mdor// rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das// mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' zhing*| |las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin kho na gsung*// lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs phyir na rgyu 'bras las gzhan min| |mang po gcig dang gcig nyid mang po dang*// me dong pad+ma'i rdzing du sgyur ba dang*// rta chag rul po'ang ro brgya ldan pa sogs// mi mtshungs blo 'das cho 'phrul mdzad pa yang*// chos kun gshis babs stong nyid yin phyir dang*// bdag rkyen rgyu dang gzhan rkyen gdul bya dang*// dus bab rten 'brel dbang gis de ltar snang*| |tshul 'di rtogs na chos rnams ma lus pa'i// gnas lugs rtogs 'gyur bstan bcos chen po 'di'i// spyi chings khog dbub dag kyang 'di kho na'o/

2 /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang*// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs su gcig gsungs pa// ji ltar shing mkhan gyi ni lag cha dang*// nad gso'i sman ltar re re'ang ma tshang na// de yi ngo skal shor ke 'byung ba ltar// sems can khams kyi nyon mongs brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gnyen por chos kyi phung po yang*// brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa gang zag gcig /'tshang rgya bar yang med thabs med pa ste// nyon mongs rtsa ba ma rig pa nyid de// de spong slad du spros bral stong nyid bsgom// nyon mongs gnyen por chos kyi phung po ste// de yi ting 'dzin gzungs dang spobs pa dang*| |rnam dag sgo dang spyod pa smon lam stobs// spang rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur/ 3 /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// lam nyid skye ba'i rim par gsungs pa yang*// brtag pa gnyis par dang por gso sbyong dag /sbyin par bya zhes go rim dang bcas mthar// de rjes dgyes pa rdo rje brtsam zhes gsungs| |de phyir skyabs sdom nas bzung bla med kyi// theg pa phyin chad gang zag skal ldan gyi// rgyud la sa lam skye phyir gcig tu nges/ 4 /chos 'khor rnam gsum 'khor gyi rtogs pa yi// khyad par bstan pa zhes gsungs de yi don// blo dman skye bor thog ma nyid du yang*// spros bral bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas bstan na// spangs kyi dogs pas dang por med pa'i mtha'| |'gog phyir 'khor lo dang por sdug bsngal dang*// kun 'byung 'gog pa lam ste bden bzhi bstan// slar yang rtag pa ther zug spong slad du// 'khor lo bar par gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar// med pa stong nyid bco brgyad dag gis bshad// de tshe yod med som nyi slar spong slad// nges don mtha' bral chos 'khor gsum pa yis// chos kun spros bral zab zhi 'dus ma byas// rang rig bden don bstan pas grol bar mdzad/

5 /chos 'khor re re la yang gsum ga tshang*// zhes pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rab shes nas// de rgyu kun 'byung de spong thabs ni lam// de 'bras 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi// de dag 'khor lo gsum ga la yod pas// 'khor lo re rer gsum ga de phyir tshang*/ 6 /chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma phyi ma yi// sa bon snga ma snga ma la gnas zhes// gsungs pa bden bzhir sdom pa'i ngo bo ni// rnam rig min par gsungs pa stong nyid de// de ni bar pa'i dgongs don yin phyir dang*| |bar par smra bsam brjod med sogs gsungs pa// tha ma spros bral nges pa'i sa bon yin// tha ma lang gshegs sogs su gzugs kyi khams// 'og min gnas su mngon sangs rgyas nas kyang*// slar yang sprul pa 'dir 'tshang rgya zhes pa// sngags kyi theg pa'i 'dod pa dag kyang gsungs/ 7 /mdo don gnad kyi 'khor lo gsum du nges// gsungs pa dgongs pa nges 'grel mdo las ni// 'khor lo gsum por dang po bar pa gnyis// rtsod pa dang bcas phyi ma rtsod med du// bzhag pa mdo don 'khor ba spong slad du// mngon rtogs rim pa rgyud la 'char dgos par// gsungs pa bdag nyid chen po sgam po pas// rnal 'byor bzhir bzhag de phyir 'khor lo gsum// mdo dang don gyi gnad kyis nges par byas/ 8 / 'dul ba'i sde snod bden bzhi'i chos 'khor zhes// gsungs pa khrims nyams sdom pa ma thob sogs// de 'bras sdug bsngal 'byung ba sdug bsngal bden// de rgyu 'chal sogs kun 'byung bden pa ste// de 'gog khrims la gnas bya 'gog bden nyid// khrims rnams sde lngar bzhag pa lam gyi bden// de phyir bden bzhi 'dul ba'i sde snod nyid| 9 |theg pa sna tshogs stong nyid nges don ni// chos kyi 'khor lo zhes gsungs de yi don// 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi bar pa ni// mtshan nyid med pa dag gi mtha' gnyis po| |so sor bsal nas mtha' bral nges pa'i don// theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa stong pa nyid// rgyu 'bras dag tu ldang zhing de nyid kyang*// spu ris sna tshogs rnams su 'jug pa ste| |lam dang 'bras bu sna tshogs theg pa'i sgo// du mar bstan kyang mthar thug gcig nyid du// nges pas 'khor lo tha ma theg pa'i sgo// sna tshogs bstan pa nges don 'khor lor bzhed| |de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo dang ni// dgongs pa nges 'grel las gsungs de phyir ro/

10 /mtha' drug dag tu gsungs pa thams cad ni// nges don 'ba' zhig ces pa'i khyad chos ni// rgyal ba gsung bden gnyis su mi gsung phyir// chos kun nges don bslu med rgyu dang 'bras// kho na bstan gyis bstan bya gzhan yod min// 'on kyang gdul bya'i khams rigs khyad par gyis// mtha' drug la sogs go lugs so sor snang*// de tshul rma bya chen mo dag dang ni// tsan+dan yan lag zla ba sgron ma dang*// gser 'od dbyangs can le'u bco lnga par// gsal por gsungs la su yis bsnyon par nus/ 11 /sems tsam ston pa'i bka' nyid dbu ma ston// gsungs pa dngos kun sems tsam las gzhan du// ma grub sems kyang yod med mtha' bral bas// de las gzhan pa'i dbu ma su yis bshad// snang sems gnyis med nyams len rtsa bar gzung*/ 12 /log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus| |zhes gsungs de yang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te// brtag na dben la don byed nus pa dang*// mthun par snang zhing rten cing 'brel 'byung bzhi'i// gnad kyi don byed nus pa drin lan ni| |bsabs mdor ri dwags 'dzin ma'i bu lnga brgya'i// dpe dang bram ze chen po'i thod chang dang*// 'dul ba lung las khron par spre'u ni// lnga brgya dus gcig gum pa'i dpe yis shes/ 13 /lam rnams thams cad sa bcus bgrod ces par// mdo sngags gang yang bgrod bya sa dang po// mthong lam sa bcu rgyun mthar shes sgrib dag |spangs nas rnam mkhyen 'thob pa gnyis ka mtshungs// de yang 'bad brtson dbang gis skad cig dang*// rim gyis bgrod pa sbyangs stobs khyad par yin/ 14 /lam rnams thams cad rim gyis 'jug ces pa// cig car rim gyis gnyis su phye na yang*// don la thams cad rim gyis pa nyid las// cig char skad cig bgrod pa ga la srid// ras sam lwa ba mang du brtsegs pa la/ /stobs ldan skyes bus nyag phran bsnun pa na// shugs des skad cig gcig la phug go zhes// smra yang snga ma ma phug phyi ma de// phug par rlom pa blun po'i khyad chos yin|

15 |shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong ba yang*// yod ces gsungs pa yang gi sgra'i nus pas// mtha' gcig ma yin phal cher las nyon shes// rim gyis spong yang gang zag la la zhig |sngon la shes sgrib spangs pas gzhan gnyis po// rang bzhin shugs kyis spongs zhes mi las gsungs/ 16 /tshad ma sangs rgyas kyi ni mkhyen pa yi// ye shes yin zhes gsungs pa 'di lta ste// slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos ji skad du// tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bde gshegs zhes pa'i lung dang ni// lugs der khyi mgo rdo ril zhes pa la// rdo ba'i gshis med de bzhin ri bong la// rwa med pa yang gshis sam babs yin phyir// chos kun babs kyi gnas lugs dpe des bstan// des na ji lta'i tshad mar gyur pa ni| |rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi thugs las gzhan yod min/ 17 /tshad ma'i 'bras bus chos nyid stong pa nyid// ston gsungs blo bdun las ni rjes dpag la// rtags bzhi'i ya gyal yang dag rtags kyis ni// 'bras bu rgyu dpog rgyu 'bras rten 'brel te// don mthun de nyid rjes dpag gis shes pas// rgyu 'bras ma rmongs ma rig dang bral zhing*// mngon sum bzhi las rang rig mngon sum dang*// rnal 'byor mngon sum zhi lhag ting 'dzin sgrub// de nyid zung 'brel zab mo stong nyid ston// rnam 'grel gzhung las gang gi dngos po rnams// rnam par brtag na dngos po de med cing*// de la gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin sogs// med par gsungs las stong nyid gzhan yod min/ 18 */grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud pa/ *// zhes gsungs pa ni mu stegs lta zhog gi /nang par gtogs shing chen por rlom rnams kyis// chos kun kun rdzob tu yod don dam par// med ces smra bas rtag chad mu gnyis po// khas blangs mu stegs dang mtshungs de yi ni// spros bral don la rmongs pas ngan song grub// dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdor// bskal pa bye bar tshul khrims bsrungs byas shing*// yun ring dus su bsam gtan sgom byed kyang*// yang dag nyid mtha' 'di ni mi shes na// bstan pa 'di la de dag blo yod min// zhes gsungs yang dag nyid mtha' gang zhe na// yod med mtha' bral bsam brjod bral min nam/

19 /mu stegs pa la'ang gshis kyi dge ba yi// bsgrub bya mang po yod ces gsungs pa ni// snying rje che dang dbyar dang dgag dbye dang*// gso sbyong la sogs de la yod pa'i phyir// gshis kyi dge ba de dag la dgongs so/ 20 /phyi nang dag gi khyad par skyabs 'gro zhes// dbu mar lta dang spyod pa snying rje dang*// bdag 'dzin spong dang chos rtags phyag rgya bzhi// de sogs gang gis kyang dbye ba mi phyed de// shākya'i dbang po ston par khas len dang*// de yi thugs la bzhugs dang gsungs pa'i chos// dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su 'gro mi 'gro// de yis 'byed kyis gzhan pa gang yang min/ 21 /theg pa che dang chung ba'i khyad par ni// sems bskyed ces gsungs de yang rgyu dang lam// 'bras bus mi phyed gzhan don kho na'i blo// phyugs rdzi mnyan pa rgyal po'i dpes bstan pa'i// rab 'bring tha ma gang rung ldan mi ldan// de yis theg pa mchog dman legs par 'byed/ 22 /sngags dang mtshan nyid khyad par dbang zhes dang*// lam dang 'jug pa 'bras bu bde ba dang*// dka' thub 'dod yon spong dang dus dang ni// rgyu 'bras kyis min bya spyod yo ga dang*// pha ma gnyis med rgyud don dbang rim gyis// dbye zhes mgon po 'bri gung pa des gsungs/ 23 /sngags dang mtshan nyid gang med gyur kyang ni| |rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi 'thob ces gsungs pa// rgyu yi theg pas spang bya rags pa dang*// 'bras bu'i theg pas phra ba spong dgos te// jo bo rje yis sngags kyi theg pa ni// pha rol phyin la brten te byang chub dag /bsgrub par gsungs sogs rnam grangs mang dag gsungs/ 24 /sdom pa gsum yang spang bya mi dge ba// bcu spong bar ni gnad gcig ces gsungs don// lus ngag yid kyis spyad pa'i mi dge ba// 'dul byang sngags gsum gang du'ang spang bya las// blang byar ma gsung mi tshangs spyod lta bu// 'dul bar pham pa byang sems kyis kyang spong*// sngags su kun+da bsrung ba gnad gcig la// de bzhin srog gcod la sogs kun dang mtshungs/

25 /bdag po 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong*| |zhes pa sdom gsum gnad gcig bzhed na yang*// bdag po'i dbye bas ming rigs tha dad gsum// dper na rgyan gyi ngo bo gser yin yang*// rgyal po blon po 'bangs kyi dbye ba yis| |rgyan de'ang gsum du 'phral ngor snang ba bzhin/ 26 /khams ni rang bzhin rnam dag bral 'bras kyi// yon tan dang ldan gsungs pa 'di lta ste// mgon po byams pas sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang*// sbun la snying po la sogs dpes bstan cing*// phal chen mdo las stong gsum dar yug dang*// gzungs dbang rgyal pos zhus mdor nor bu ni// bkru dang phyi sogs bya ba dpes bstan pas// rigs khams de la bral 'bras yon tan kun// babs kyis ldan yang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te// mkha' la snang ba'i rta bdun dbang po la// 'od zer babs kyis snang yang chu 'dzin gyis// bsgribs na nyi 'od mi mthong nyid dang mtshungs// de yang ma pham rgyal ba'i zhal gyi lung*// ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang*// gnas skabs de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba'i don// rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni// don dam dbyings kyi dgongs don yin zhes bya// de skad gsungs phyir de nyid kho nar nges/ 27 /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun po// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod ces pa// mthar thug sangs rgyas sa yi yon tan kun// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por yod gsungs na// byang chub phyogs chos lta smos ci zhig dgos// gal te de med na ni rgyu med pa'i// 'bras bu 'byung ba su zhig smra bar byed/ 28 /tshad med bzhi ni de bzhin gshegs pa yi// snying po sangs rgyas nyid kyi ngo bo nyid// ces gsungs pa yang byams dang snying rje dang*// dga' ba btang snyoms tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi po// de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs te snying po nyid// de phyir rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor yang*// gzhi lam 'bras bu kun tu de ldan nyid/

29 /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rigs gcig theg pa gcig ces gsungs pa ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa la// 'di ni theg chen 'di ni theg chung gi /rigs yin de la theg pa'ang de ltar ston// snyam pa'i blo med dus kun mtha' gnyis bral// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyi ni// rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo las ni// 'dren pa sems can rnams la mnyam pa'i thugs// nga la tha dad 'du shes nam yang med// theg pa dman pa gzhan la ngas bstan na// de la nga ni ser sna'i skyon du 'gyur// zhes gsungs phyir na rigs dang theg pa gcig 30 /log sred can dang nyan thos rnams kyang ni// mthar thug byang chub chen por 'gyur gsungs pa// log sred can dang nyan thos de rnams la'ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de yod phyir// de las yid phyung theg chen la zhugs te// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa gshis sam babs yin te// zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las 'di skad du// bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab// 'di na snod min sems can gang yang med// ces dang mgon po byams pas sems can rnams// sangs rgyas nyid de glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs phyir nges par gzung*// chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms dang po'o/// / ༈ 1 /dge dang mi dge gnyis su thag bcad na// lung ma bstan med gsungs pa dug gsum gyi// bsam pa gang 'dres mi dge de las gzhan// dge bar nges pas bar ma nyid med la// gsum tshugs ya gyal gsungs pa'ang shes sgrib la// dgongs pas mi dge'i khongs su shugs kyis 'du| |dper na khyim tshang zhig la pha dang ma/ /bu mor bcas tshe bgrang bya gsum yod kyang*// ma dang bu mo bud med rigs gcig pas// pho mo gnyis las gzhan med de dang mtshungs| 2 |rtog gnyis cig car mi 'jug sems gnyis kyang*// 'grogs par mi skye zhes pa gang zag ni// gcig la sems gnyis med phyir skad cig la// dge sdig bsam pa lhan cig 'byung mi srid// ji ltar snang mun lhan cig 'grogs min ltar// res 'jog las gzhan lhan cig 'byung mi srid/

3 /sems las byung ba las kyang sems 'byung zhes// gsungs pa sems nyid 'od gsal spros bral las// rang snang rang mdangs shar ba sems byung ste// de las slar yang sems nyid 'byung ba ste// dper na 'di bya snyam pa skad cig ma// sems yin de dag sgrub byed thabs bsam pa// sems byung yin gyi de nyid grub zin pa'i// rtog pa skad cig ma ste sems yin pas// sems dang sems byung res mos 'khor zhing skye/ 4 /'khor ba lus 'khor bya ba sems nyid dngos// spros bral stong nyid 'od gsal 'dzin med de// dngos sam yid kyi lus la ma brten na// sems nyid stong pas bde sdug nyams myong gang*/ /rigs drug dngos lus bar do bag chags kyi/ /rang gzugs rlung sems las grub sgyu ma ltar/ /'byung phyir 'khor ba lus 'khor zhes pa bstan| 5 |rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad ma rig pa'i// g.yos zhes gsungs pa rtsa ba ma rig pa// zhes pa brgyal lam gnyid dam 'bog pa sogs// dran pa nyams la btags pa ma yin gyi/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba la btags de las ni/ /'du byed de las gzhan rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ /dper na ma med pa la bu dang ni/ /bu mo 'byung ba mi srid de bzhin no/ 6 /rten 'brel bcu gnyis skad cig ma gcig la// tshang zhes gsungs pa rtog pa skad cig mar// zhe sdang skyes pa 'khrul blo ma rig pa// des bskyed gshe dang rdeg sogs 'du byed nas// rim gyis bskyed pa skad cig de la rdzogs/ 7 /sems tha dad pa'i babs kyis snang ba yang*// tha dad gsungs pa mchog dman thams cad kyi// sems nyid tha dad phyir na de'i snang ba// kun kyang tha dad 'byung ba dper brjod na// chu la lha yi bdud rtsi mi yi chu// yi dwags rnams kyi snag khrag tu mthong ba// sems tha dad las snang ba de der snang*| |rdzogs sangs rgyas la dag pa'i snang ba ste// zag can rnams la las kyi snang ba 'byung*/

8 /da lta nyid du gang bsgrubs pa dag gi /'bras bu longs spyod gsungs pa nas bsgrub slad| |so nam byas pas 'bras bu nas 'byung ltar// rtsol bas bsgrubs las 'byung ba ji skad du// brkos par gyur na sa las chu yang thon// gtsubs par gyur na shing la me yang 'bar| |mis ni brtson 'grus dang 'bad byas gyur na// mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med par gsungs/ 9 /dus kyi 'phel 'grib da ltar yang bya ba// yod ces gsungs pa bskal pa dang po la// las ngan smin pa'i skye bos gsog 'jog sogs// bgyis pas tshe lo bcu par thug pa'i tshe// byams pa'i sprul pas dge ba'i khrims bcas pas// brgyad khrir 'phel ltar don la 'di lta ste// gang gi rgyud la tshul khrims rnam dag na// de la sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel zhes bya// de ni khrims 'chal zag par gyur pa na// de la bstan pa 'grib pa zhes brjod do/ 10 /tshe 'di rang du mthong chos gtso bor 'byung*// gsungs pa skyes bu dman pa la la zhig /sdom gsum gang rung rgyud ldan bgyis pa na// sngon dus kun gyis brnyas byar gyur pa de// phyis nas yongs kyi zhing gi dam par 'gyur// ji ltar bdag gis gzhan la phan byas na// tshur la'ang phan pa sgrub kyi phar rgol na// tshur la'ang rgol ba mthong chos 'bras bu yin/ 11 /mi chos bcu drug la sogs lha chos dang*// gcig ces gsungs pa mi yi chos lugs la// mchog dman gnyis las mchog ni dge bcu'i steng*// pha la pha dang ma la mar shes pa// dge sbyong bram ze la yang der shes bzhi// rgan la rim gro sbyin la dga' ba ste// de ltar bcu drug spyad na mi rnams kyi// nang nas mchog tu 'dzin mod lha chos la'ang*// de rnams med mi rung bas gcig ces gsungs// skye ngan spyod pa de las log pa yi// mi chos ngan pa lha chos dang gcig par// ma gsungs phyir na rnam dbye phyed pa gces| 12 |phal che chung las 'bras bu thob pa ni// rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhes dgongs pa'i don// 'bras bu sgrub pa lung dang rtags tsam 'dzin// bzhi po snga ma rnams las 'bras thob kyi// phyi mar gtan mi 'thob pa ma yin te// 'bras dus phal che rim gyis nyung ba la// dgongs te mkha' 'gro dus 'byung las gsungs pa// tshe lo bcu par rdo rta can gyi dus| |dgra bcom gnyis 'byung gzhan yang da lta'i dus// gnas gzhan du yang dgra bcom bzhugs par 'chad// de bas skyes bu'i rtsol ba la rag gi

/dus kyis byas min de la snyad mi gdags| 13 |lhag pa shes rab bslab pa sngon du ni// 'gro ba'ang yod gsungs bslab pa gzhan gnyis po// sngon du 'gro ba kho nar ma nges te// dpon slob rten 'byung slob mas yon tan dag /thob pa shes rab bslab pa de bskyed pa'i// thabs sgom pa ni ting 'dzin bslab pa ste// de yis tshul khrims bsrung ba tshul khrims kyi// bslab pa yin la yang gi sgras bstan pa| |rnam pa gcig tu nges min don la dgongs/ 14 /lam rim thams cad thun gcig dag gis ni// nyams su blang zhing gsungs pa nyin mtshan gyi// thun khongs re la'ang rnyed dka' mi rtag pa// rgyu 'bras nyes dmigs skyabs 'gro sdig bshags dang*// tshogs gsog gsol 'debs smon 'jug bskyed rim dang*// bla sgrub mnyam bzhag bsngo bas rgyas 'debs sogs// lam rim go ma log pa 'bad de bsgom// res 'jog mi bya tshang ba gnad du che/ 15 /sangs rgyas mang po zhing khams gcig nyid du'ang*// rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhes gsungs pa ni/ /zhing 'dir zhing gzhan bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// byon nas dam pa'i chos mang gsungs pa dang*/ /zhing gi gtso bo sangs rgyas de nyid la| |rgyal ba gzhan kun yab dang yum sras dang*// rim gro pa dang mchog sprul la sogs pa// mtha' yas ston pa dper na bdag cag gi /ston pa'i sras su rdo rje sems dpa' nyid| |sras tshul sgra gcan 'dzin du grags pa dang*// kun dga' bo ni rdo rje 'chang sogs te// mtha' yas mdzad pa mi mtshungs ltar snang yang*// gshis sam babs te mi 'khrul cho 'phrul la// blo dman rtog ge'i gzhal bya rang nyes rgyu// kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms gnyis pa'o// // ༈ 1 /'dul ba theg pa thun mong yin gsungs pa| |ji ltar 'dir ni shing rtsa gtso bo ste// rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi// de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams kun gyi yang*// gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs| |zhes pa'i lung gis chos rnams 'phel ba dang*// 'dzin pa'i rtsa bar gsungs pa thun mong nyid// theg chung dag gi chos rnams kun 'dzin dang*// 'phel bar 'gyur min de phyir thun mong ngo*/

2 /lhag par theg pa chen por bzhugs pa gsal// zhes gsungs pa ni rnam 'byed lung nyid las// sangs rgyas rnams dang rang rgyal rnams kyis kyang*// byang chub gang brnyes thugs slob rnam dag pa'i// sems can dgra bcom yon tan ldan pa rnams// de yang rgyu ni 'dul ba yin par gsungs// zhes pas sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub ni// gang brnyes 'dul bar gsungs pas theg chen du// nges kyi theg dman lam des sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' 'thob pa ga la srid/ 3 /tshul khrims rin po che ni thams cad dag |mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin par gsungs pa ni// ston pa mya ngan 'das khar gsol btab par// ston pa dam chos 'dul bar gyis gsungs pas// thams cad mkhyen dngos yin par lung gis grub/ 4 /skye ba'i bar chad thams cad 'bras bu dag /'thob pa'i bar chad yin par gsungs pa'i don// mtshams med la sogs bar chad can rnams la/ /sdom pa skye yang 'bras thob mi 'byung ste/ /pha ma bsad dang sprul pa la sogs la// sdom pa skyes kyang lus des rnam mkhyen gyi// 'bras bu ma thob gleng gzhi dag las shes| 5 |sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ni// ma yin pa yi gzugs su bzhed pa ni// chos mngon mdzod las so thar sdom pa ni// rnam rig min pa'i gzugs su gsungs pa dang*| |rgyu rkyen tshang las thob pa'i sdom pa la// gsol bzhi'i las kyi brjod pa tha ma yi// gzhan brjod la bab sdom pa thob shes pa'i// rang gzugs yid kyi rnam shes yul gyur pa| |mig gis mthong min dbang po'i yul ma gyur// de la bzhed pa rnam dag dgongs don yin/ 6 /ltung ba mtha' dag la ni 'du shes gtso// zhes gsungs pa ni lus ngag yid gsum las// phyi ma med na snga ma bem po la// ltung dang ltung min tha snyad su yis 'jog /shes gtso 'du shes dag pa nyid na'o// zhes pa 'dul mdor lan mang gsungs pa dang*// yid sdom legs na sdom kun legs gsungs shing*// dge slong gnyid log tshogs can mas bkab dang*// ser skya bzang mo'i gleng gzhir reg pa la// bdag gir ma byas ltung med gsungs pas grub/

7 /gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong zhes gsungs pa// snga mas rtogs 'gyur gzhan yang klu zhabs kyis// dug gsum gyis bskyed mi dger gsungs pa yang*| |yid kyis bskyed la lus ngag gtsor bya min// nges 'byung bsam pa'ang yid las skye dgos kyi// lus ngag dag las nges 'byung bsam pa ci// chos kun sngon du yid 'gro yid gtso bar/ /gsungs pas 'di don go ba gal che'i gnad/ /la las sdom pa lus ngag las skye zhes// bshad mod sems med bem po dag dang ni// sgra las sdom pa skye ba de ya mtshan| 8 |gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba'ang*// yod ces gsungs pa bslab pa phul ba la// mu bzhir gsungs pa'i phul nyams gnyis ka dag /byas na gtong la gzhan gsum gyis mi gtong*// mdzod las shi 'phos pas ni gtong gsungs pa// theg dman kho nar dgongs kyi skabs don 'dir// mnyam med rgyal ba gnyis pa 'bri gung pas// 'dul ba theg chen nyid du bzhed pas na// theg chen sdom pa shi nas gtong 'dod na// rnam par log smra'i brtul zhugs de ci ga /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams goms byas na| |mi rnams la ni 'dris pa nyid du 'gyur// de lta bu dag ched du ma bsgrub kyang*// srid pa gzhan la rmi lam bzhin du spyod// ces pa phal chen mdo las gsungs pa'i don// tshe 'dir dge slong sdom la goms byas na// de 'bras med min de dag shi 'phos nas// ched du gsol bzhi'i las kyis ma bsgrub kyang*// srid pa gzhan der rmi lam ji bzhin du// bag chags dbang gis dge slong nyid du 'gyur// gal te de nyid sngon 'bras tsam las gzhan// dge slong rnam dag min na sngon 'bras las// lhag pa'i 'bras bu med pa ma yin nam// snying rje pad dkar mdo ru 'jig rten khams// dri sngo snang ba rdul bral zhing du ni// sangs rgyas snang ba rdul bral spos mtho ba// dbang phyug rgyal drung bag chags sad pa yi// lha yi dge slong yod par gsungs pa dang*// khri rkang dag gi gleng gzhir gsungs pas kyang*// mngon sum grub bo 'di don go bar bya// 'ang sgras mtha' gcig kho nar nges pa med/

9 /pham pa bzhi ni bu lon nor can ltar// bzhed pa kha che bye smra'i lugs yin te// pham pa gcig byung gzhan gsum ma gos na// nyams pa yin yang btang ba min pa'i phyir// bslab bskyar tshe na sdom ro 'bul dgos pa// de la dgongs kyi deng sang 'dul 'dzin 'gas// pham pa dang pos gos na gzhan rnams ni// ma phul bar yang sdom pa bskyar ba mthong*// so sor thar pa'i bstan pa 'jig ltas yin/ 10 /sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu'ang mya ngan las// 'das pa thob ces gsungs pa 'di lta ste// snying rje pad dkar mdo lung don bsdu na// rab byung nyams pa bu yi lag 'jus nas// chang skyogs khyim du rgyu ba zhig yin yang*// sangs rgyas sar dad rgyu 'bras yid ches shing*// dkar po'i chos la phyi bshol med brtson na// mos pa'i dus mthar mya ngan 'da' bar gsungs// lha btsun sngon mo'i gtam rgyud dag dang sbyar/ 11 /bcas pa dang ni rang bzhin gyi kha na// ma tho ba dag gcig par gsungs pa ni// rgyal ba nye ring mi mnga' kun la snyoms// de phyir srog gcod rku rdzun la sogs pa// mi dge'i phyogs kun spong bar gsungs pa la// pham lhag la sogs bcas pa'i ming tsam las// don du bcas rang gcig par mi 'dod na// bcas 'gal mi la sogs pa srog bcad pas// rab byung dag la nyes pa'i rgyur 'gyur la// khyim par de la sdig pa med ma gsungs// de phyir skabs don ming gi brda chad las// don la khyad par med 'di ma go na// rgyu 'bras phyogs re gol ba'i nyen mchis so/ 12 /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal pos 'gro ba rnams// spyi la bcas gsungs rang re'i ston pa 'dis// dang po thugs bskyed nas bzung mthar byang chub// thob pa'i bar gyi mdzad pa ji snyed pa// 'gro kun don phyir yin gyi re re yi// don min de phyir mngon sangs rgyas nas ni// blang dor bcas pa 'ga' zhig la mdzad pa// la lar ma mdzad phyogs lhung can yin phyir// rgyal ba gnyis 'dzin can du ma thal lam// rgyal ba nges gsungs so sor thar pa yi// tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus las// sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang*// lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya// zhes pa dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud las gsungs/

13 /sdig ltung tha dad med cing gcig gsungs pa// zan dang bshos kyi ming ltar gcig pa ste// ltung ba ltung ba zhes su bya ba ni// sems can dmyal ba dud 'gro gshin rje yi// 'jig rten dag tu ltung phyir ltung bar brjod// rnam 'byed lung don de phyir sdig ltung ba// gnyis ka'i 'bras bus ngan song 'gro ba dang*// de rgyu mi dge sdig pa nyid yin phyir| |sdig ltung rgyu 'bras gcig la su yis bsnyon/ 14 /spyir ni bkag pa thams cad ye bkag la// gnang ba thams cad ye gnang gsungs pa dang*// rgyal ba mtha' gnyis dang ni snga phyi dag /'gal ba gsung mi srid pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// mi tshangs spyod sogs ye nas bkag pa la// dgos pa'i dbang gis phyis su gnang ba med// chos gos gsum sogs ye nas gnang ba la// skabs don dbang gis phyis kyang bkag pa med// bud med la reg lhag mar gsungs pa la// de dag chus khyer na ni 'dzin gnang ba// bong ba'i 'du shes bskyed par gsungs des na// bud med la reg ye nas ma gnang zhing*// bong bar reg pa ye nas ma bkag la// 'du shes gtso ba'ang gnas 'dis gsal bar byas// la las ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba'i// chos skad ngo mtshar che bar grags ces pa'i// bsting tshig smras kyang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rnams// rgyal ba gnyis pas dgongs kyi gzhan gyis min/ 15 /'gro drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon 'byung*// zhes pa kā shi'i nags kyi sems can ni// chen po bzhi yis gtan khrims bsrungs bas shes/ 16 /'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das shing*// nyes pa 'byung bar gsungs pa'ang 'di lta ste// ldog pa tha dad rgyu mtshan snga mas mtshungs/ 17 /bstan pa la ni cho ga lhag par yang*// gal che gsungs pa sngags pa khyim pa yis// rtags dang cho ga bya bar ma gsungs pa'i// khyad par rab tu byung la dgongs pa ste// mngon gyur bcu tshang des chog des 'ong gi/ */byas so thob pa'i tshig la zhen spangs nas// rgyal gsung dpang du bzhag pa gsol bzhi'i las// ma 'khrul bzhag par mi 'os pa dag gis// legs par bsgrubs pa rgyal ba'i bstan pa yin// mkhan slob zla bsgril kha skong grangs ma tshang*// cho ga chad lhag la sogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i// mkhan po'i ming de bstan pa'i gshed ma yin/

18 /mi shes pa ni lhag par gti mug pas| |nyes pa che bar gsungs pas nyes kun gyi// rtsa ba ma rig pa nyid yin pa'i phyir// rgyu 'bras spang gnyen la rmongs 'jol nyog spyod// dge sdig ngo ma shes pas nyon mongs kun// rang gar bag med spyad pas ngan song gsum// gtan du nyo ba'i blun pos sa steng khyab/ 19 /dud 'gro gti mug che bas dman gsungs pa// dmyal bar skyes la 'du shes gsum 'byung bas| |'gyod pa skye zhing dge ba'i sems skye bas// thar bar 'gyur yang yi dwags rnams la yang*// shes pa gsal bas snga ma dag dang mtshungs// dud 'gro rmongs pas bde sdug tshor tsam las// gzhan pa'i snang ba med pas lus de nyid// bor yang ngan 'gro gzhan du kha brgyud pas// lhag par dman pa'i dgongs don de ltar grags/ 20 /nyams pa'i nyes pa bas ni ma thob pa'i// nyes pa lci zhes gsungs pa 'di lta ste// nyams pa de la thog mar sdom len tshe// srung sems nges 'byung dag gis mtshams sbyar bas// phyi dus nyams kyang sngon sems dge ba yi// 'bras bu 'byung gi ma thob pa rnams la// thog mtha' bar kun bsam pa de med pas// de ltar dgongs kyi 'jam dpal gnang ba'i mdor// sangs rgyas spyan gyis zhing gang ngas mthong ba// rin chen bkang ste de bzhin gshegs byin yang*// 'di lta bu yi chos de ma thos na// de ni bsod nams chung zhes nga smra'o// zhes dang sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa yi// mdo lung tshigs su bcad der 'di skad smra// tshul khrims nyams shing sdig spyod dge slong de// ngas bstan 'dul bar mi ro ltar gsungs mod// 'on kyang sngon dus rab byung khrims bsrungs pa'i// yon tan lhag pa'i mthu dag yod pas na// dper na khyu mchog dang ni gla ba dag /shi na byol song nang gi ro yin yang*// khyu mchog gi wang gla bar ma gi ta// yod pas 'gro ba gzhan la phan pa ltar// tshul 'chal dge slong ro dang 'dra na yang*// rab byung khrims mnos yon tan lhag pa'i mthus// rang dang sems can dpag tu med pa la// phan dang bde ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur zhes gsungs// gzhan yang pham pa 'chab med byung ba yi// sdom ro phul nas bskyar bas grol 'bras 'thob// lhag ma la sogs phyir bcos kyis dag ste// rnam grol 'bras bu 'thob phyir bshes spring las// gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las// phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa na// zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te| |dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin// zhes gsungs de lta bas na mkhas pa yi// sdig pa yang la rmongs pa'i sdig che ste// slob dpon chen po dbyig gi gnyen des kyang*| |mi shes sdig pa byas pa shin tu lci// mkhas pas sdig pa byas pa yang bar 'gyur// lcags kyi gong bu chung yang gting du 'gro// de nyid snod byas che yang mkha' la 'phyo// zhes sogs lung don mang pos grub la ltos// 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms gsum pa'o/// /

༈ 1 /snying rje dang ni byang chub kyi sems gnyis// tha dad yin zhes gsungs pa snying rje ni// theg pa mchog dman phyi nang kun la yod// byang chub sems ni theg chen 'ba' zhig gi// khyad chos yin mod snying rje byang sems kyi// rgyu yin dngos min slob dpon zla bas kyang*// nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing*// snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*// byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu// zhes gsungs phyir na rgyu la dngos mi 'khrul/ 2 /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa// rten can bya ba byang sdom len pa'i sngon| |skyabs 'gro la sogs rgyu bzhi gsungs pa'i phyir// a ti shas kyang so thar ris bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan la byang sems kyi// sdom pa'i skal ba yod kyi gzhan min gsungs/ 3 /so so'i skye bo la yang 'jug pa ni// skye zhes gsungs pa pham 'dra'i nyes byas bzhi// sa thob sems dpar 'byung min zla bas gsungs// de yang so skyer dgongs la zhi lhas kyang*// sa ma 'thob la 'jug sdom skye bar bzhed/ 4 /ci rigs kyis ni tshul khrims dag gis kyang*// sdom par 'gyur gsungs sdom gsum mtha' dag pa// rdzogs par byed pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi// spyod yul yin gyi sa bcu'i sems dpas kyang*// de 'dra nus min de phyir ci rigs pa// sna res kyang ni sdom pa rab 'gyur ba| |mi sbyin mi skye'i chos la bzod thob kyang*// srog gcod gcig pu spong bar khas blangs ltar/ 5 /nyon mongs can min ltung ba med gsungs pa// chags sogs nyon mongs yid kyis ma dkrug na// ltung ba 'byung min me med du ba dag /'byung ba mi srid mngon sum tshad mas grub/ 6 /nyes par mi 'gyur ba yi mi dge ba// de dag gnang ba med ces 'dir gsungs pa// 'phrul ngag bden pa'i mdo las 'di skad gsungs// dbang med las kyi rnam smin 'byung ba la// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mnga' mi mdzad// ces gsungs nyes par mi 'gyur mi dge ba// srid min tsha sreg bya ba mi byed pa'i// me nyi mi srid pa dang mtshungs pa yin/

7 /thabs mkhas pa la mi dge ba yod na// de yi 'bras bu 'byung zhes gsungs pa ni// byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas spyod pa la// mi dge mi srid yod na 'bras bu 'byung*// las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab// snying rje'i bdag nyid can yang dud 'gror skye// zhes pa skyes pa'i rabs su gsungs la sogs// tshad grub lung dang rigs pa mtha' yas so/ 8 /rang gzhan brjes pas nyes par 'gyur ba yi// skabs yod gsungs pa bsam dang bsam sbyor dang*// gnyis ka'i stobs kyis brtul zhugs tha 'bring rab// skabs bstun rang gzhan brje ba'ang der mtshungs te// lam zhugs dang pos byas na nyams par 'gyur// nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las 'di skad gsungs// ji ltar sman shing ljon pa lta sdug pa// rtsa ba la sogs sa bon spyad 'os rnams// byin yang dus min spyod las bsrung bya ba// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman shing ji bzhin no// zhes dang shā ri'i pu tras mig byin pa'i// gtam rgyud dang sbyar skabs kyi sgras bshad pas// rnam pa kun tu nyes min skabs shes gnad/ 9 /byang chub sems dpa' la ni gnod byas pa// bde bar 'brel mi srid ces gsungs pa ni// so skye rmongs la gnod kyang nyes 'gyur na| |sems dpa' che la gnod pas bde mi srid/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la// ngan sems cung zad skyed par byed na yang*// ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni// dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs// zhes pa rgyal sras zhi lhas gsungs min nam// spre'u byang sems dbu la rdo bsnun dang*// rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis gleng gzhis gsal/ 10 /dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu nges par ni// so sor 'byung gsungs rgyu 'bras dpang bzhag pa'i// grub mtha' 'di la su zhig rgol bar nus// dge 'bras bde dang mi dge'i 'bras sdug bsngal// 'byung ba rgyal ba'i gsung dang gshis sam babs// rgyu 'bras log par smra ba'i bshes gnyen 'gas// 'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed mi dge dang*// 'phen byed mi dge rdzogs byed dge zhes dang*// las dkar rnam smin nag dang las nag por// rnam smin dkar sogs rgyu 'bras ngo mtshar can// rgyal bas gcig tu dkar la 'bras bde dang*// gcig tu nag la 'bras bu sdug bsngal ba// 'dres ma'i las la 'bras bu 'dres ma zhes// gsungs pa sa bon nas la 'bras bu'ang nas// sran ma la ni sran ma 'byung mod kyi// 'dres ma'i nas la sran ma 'byung min te// nas sran 'dres la 'bras bu'ang gnyis 'dres dgongs// de ni ded dpon snying rje chen po yis// tshong phrug gzhan don g.yon can gsod sems ni// bdag gzhan brjes pa dge ba'i bsam pa ste// g.yon can bsad pa'i sbyor ba mi dge ba// las kyang bdag gzhan brjes pas bskal mang gi// tshogs bzlums sbyor ba nag las seng ldeng gi// tshal pa zug dang rad rod can du gzims// rta chag rul pa gsol sogs so sor smin// 'di ni dkar nag zang thal kho na ste// gzhan dag de la smod kyang de la min// rgyu 'bras smad phyir de 'bras ci 'dra na/

11 /brjed pa'i rgyu las byang chub kyi ni sems// 'chor mi srid ces gsungs pa 'di lta ste// bsod nams bsdus pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdor// byang chub sems dpa' nag po'i chos bzhi dang*// ldan na byang sems brjed par 'gyur gsungs kyi/ */'chor zhes ma gsungs dkon brtsegs sdong rgyan sogs/ */ theg chen mdo rnams dag tu gsal por gsungs// gtong zhing 'chor ba'i rgyu dngos log lta ste// de min gang gis kyang de nyid gtong mi srid/ 12 /sgrib gsum nyon mongs sgrib pa zhes gsungs pa// spyi ming nyon mongs chags sogs sgos ming ste// nyon mongs med na chags sogs ci phyir 'byung*// de med de mi 'byung phyir rtogs par sla| |nor bzang chu skyes spre'u ru ru bzhin/ 13 /bden pa dag ni grub mtha' ji snyed pas// sgrib ces gsungs pa chos nyid don dam pa'i// bden pa spros pa kun dang bral ba la| |rang gzhan stong dang yod dang med la sogs// blos byas 'dzin stangs rtog ge'i lung rigs kyi// kha bshad sprin gyis bden don nyi ma bsgribs// don dam bden pa phra phyir thos pa dang*| |don dam phyir na bsam dang zab pa'i phyir// 'jig rten phal pa'i sgom gyis mi rtogs gda'// gsungs dang gzhan yang rgyal sras zhi ba lhas// don dam blo yi spyod yul min pa la| |blo ni kun rdzob ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ 14 /nyan thos kyis kyang phyogs gcig babs kyi ni// gnas lugs mthong zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don yang*// nyan thos dag gis rgyal gsung nyams blangs pas// phyi nang gzung 'dzin ma grub mi rtag pa// rdul phran skad cig mar shes der brten nas// chags med ye shes 'byung 'gyur des 'khor ba// spong zhing 'da' ba babs kyi gnas lugs mthong*// de ni rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs dang*// gcig ste de lung don bsdus 'di lta ste// nyan thos rnams kyi chos dbyings rnam grol gnyis| |nga yi chos dbyings rnam grol dang gcig gsungs/

15 /sa drug man chad nyan rang dag dang ni// mngon rtogs thun mong yin zhes gsungs pa ni// nyan thos 'phags pa dgra bcom pa dag dang*// sa lnga thob pa'i sems dpas bden bzhi rtogs// rang sangs rgyas dang sa drug thob pa yi// sems dpas rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs so zhes// sa bcu'i mdor gsungs de phyir mngon rtogs dag /thun mong yin yang yon tan khyad par che// ka la piṅka'i bu mo mya ngan med// de sogs sdong po rgyan par mang du gsungs/ 16 /sems tsam dag ni sa bdun gyi mngon rtogs// ring du song zhes gsungs pa rten 'brel ni// lugs 'byung lugs ldog rtogs pas ma rig pa// rtogs pa'i shes rab ces zer sa bdun par// thabs kyi phar phyin mngon du 'gyur bar gsungs// de la nyan rang dag gis 'jug mi nus// lang kar gshegs mdor sems tsam sa bdun pa// snang med sa brgyad sa gnyis gnas yin te// bcu pa ye shes chen po nga yi sa// zhes gsungs pa yang bcu gcig sar bzhed do/ 17 /chos kyi bdag med pa ni sa brgyad par// mngon du byas zhes gsungs pa 'di lta ste// gang zag bdag med pa ni sa dang por// spong la chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad par// spong ba rgya cher rol ba'i mdo las kyang*// gang tshe 'di ni skye 'chi gang med pa| |chos 'di thams cad rang bzhin bdag med pa'i// bzod pa bdag gis thob pa de yi tshe// sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bdag lung bstan// ces gsungs phyir na sangs rgyas mthong zhes bya/ 18 /rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus pa// bgrod ces gsungs pa sems nyid ngo shes nas// nyams blangs cung zad gsal bar phyogs pa ni// tshogs sbyor gnyis yin de yi ngo bo dag /mthong ba mthong lam sa rab dga' ba ste// mthar thug rtogs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa// de yang ji skad ting 'dzin rgyal po las// mi gang ting 'dzin mchog de 'dzin pa de// rab tu dga' dang dri med 'od 'byed dang*// 'od 'phro shin tu sbyang dka' mngon gyur dang*// ring du song dang mi g.yo legs pa'i blo// chos sprin sa bcu po dag 'thob par 'gyur| |zhes gsungs des na sa lam mang bshad kyang*/

/rtogs pa gcig pa'i ngo bor tha dad med/ 19 /sa yi yon tan 'byung tshul mu drug ces// gsungs pa sa thob de ma thag tu ni| |yon tan 'byung min nyi ma shar ma thag /grang ba skyob pa'i dro 'jam 'byung min ltar// rim gyis cig car 'ga' zhig yod pa la// 'ga' zhig med dang 'ga' zhig yod kyang ni| |mi mthong ba dang nyams kyi snang ba dang*// lung gi mu ste drug tu bzhed pa ni// bdag cag ston pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// nor bzang bla ma klu sgrub mi pham pa// lung ni sa bcu'i mdo las sa dang po// thob nas rgyal por skyes te pha rol phyin// nyams blangs rab byung khrims bsrungs don bsgoms nas// bsam gtan bzhi dang mngon shes lnga thob pas// dri med sa thob 'go rtsom yon tan ni// brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung zhes gsungs pa la// 'ga' zhig nyi ma de ring shar ba yi// 'od zer nangs par 'byung ba mtshar zhes lo// de ni sa bcu'i mdo la rgol nus pa'i// stobs can ngo mtshar can de deng gang bzhugs/ 20 /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad du// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsag ces gsungs pa// rgyu la yod pa lam du byas nas kyang*// 'bras bu de nyid mngon gyur thabs kyi gtso// tshogs gnyis las gzhan med la de dag kyang*// bsod nams tshogs las gzugs sku ye shes las// chos sku 'byung gsungs tshogs ma bsag pa yi// sangs rgyas byung na ngo mtshar rmad du che/ 21 /mthon dman gang du'ang zhing ni gdam pa dag /gnad zab gsungs pa lung don bsdus bshad na// dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dang bram ze ni// gtsang ma gcig mnyam de nyid nyis stong ni// dge slong gcig mnyam de nyid nyis stong dang*| |dge slong zag med gcig mnyam de nyis stong*// ye shes ldan pa gcig mnyam de nyis stong*// slob dpon gcig dang yon gnas mnyam par gsungs/ 22 /ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs gsog pa// thabs mkhas bya ba bdag med gnyis rtogs phyir// dngos kun blos blangs bdag tu bzung nas ni// tshogs bsag phyir 'bul rgyal sras zhi ba lhas| |yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog

/sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje can rnams kyis| |bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// zhes sogs gsungs pa dam pa'i bdag ces bya/ 23 /'khor 'das kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ni// bsngo ba zhes gsungs 'khor ba rigs drug dang*// myang 'das sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang sogs// kun gyis dus gsum bsags dge bde gshegs khams// kun kyang bdag tu bzung la bsngo byas ste| |rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba bcu pa las// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang po reg gyur cig /rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslab bya ste// ji snyed gang yod mtha' dag ma lus dang*// khams rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdus byas te// ci nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug par bsngo// zhes gsungs la las ji snyed mang po'i sgra// chos kyi dbyings la mang nyung med ces pa// klan ka 'dod kyang 'dir ni ji snyed sgra// dus gsum dge tshogs mang la bsnyegs pa ste// chos dbyings don min de la khams zhes bsgrags// mang sgra chos dbyings la 'khrul mkhas pa de// 'degs nus nor 'dzin khyon 'di rmad byung ngo*/ 24 /sangs rgyas dang ni bla ma dag la yang*// bsngo ba dgos zhes gsungs pa rgyu ji bzhin// 'bras bu 'byung ba chos nyid yin pa dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dpal ldan bla ma la// sgrib sbyong bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab mi 'tshal yang*// de yi bzhed dgongs 'gro don sgrub pa la// bar gcod med cing myur du 'grub pa dang*// de la bsngos pas bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams// dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs byed gnad dam pa// yin phyir de ltar bsngo la 'bad par bya/ /bslab pa byang chub sems dpa'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms bzhi pa'o/// / ༈ 1 /sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la'ang 'byung gsungs pa// rnam snang mngon byang lung don 'dir bsdu na// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyang gsang sngags kyi// chos 'di mkhyen pas byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa brnyes par gsungs pa dang*// mtshan brjod las kyang dus gsum kun 'byung ba'i// sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsang sngags gsungs par bshad// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi lung don yang*// sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes bya sngon byung ba// de tshe sa 'dir 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la// legs par sbyin don gsang sngags theg pa gsungs// zhes sogs lung dang zhing rnams gang gang du// mdo sngags gtso cher bstan dang ma bstan pa'i// khyad tsam srid kyi zhing gzhan ston pa yis// gsang sngags mi mkhyen par ni 'gyur srid na// thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan don dngos dang 'gal/

2 /dbang don rgyud la skyes na thob gsungs pa// bskur thob ming la zhen pa'i dbang de ni| |chu bsrubs pa las mar nyid mi 'byung ltar// bum dbang reg bde gsang dbang zhu bde ni// thig le gsum gyi ye shes ngo 'phrod cing*// shes rab bde stong zung 'jug dpe'i ye shes| |bzhi pas spros bral lhan skyes don gyi ni// ye shes rang ngo 'phrod na nges dbang thob// gzhan pa'i dbang bskur dpon slob ngal ba'i rgyu// lha ni phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur du// 'gro zhes gsungs pa gong du bshad pa ltar// dbang don skyes dang ma skyes ma gtogs pa// gdan gsum tshang dang ma tshang ci phyir brtsi// gdan gsum dngos tshang 'dus pa 'jam rdor tsam// gzhan kun dbang bskur go chod po min na// ha cang thal bas nongs pa gang du 'jog /don gyi gdan gsum phung khams skye mched tshogs| |gang yod de la gdan gsum tshang ba'i phyir// dbang bskur ba la lha grangs mang nyung med/ 4 /dpe dang don gyi rtogs pa ma skyes na// don ni khong du mi chud ces gsungs pa| |dpe la brten nas don la nges pa skye// zla ba ston pa'i mdzub mo ji bzhin te// dbang don dpes bstan de tshe don go yang*// ma bsgom rtogs pa mi skye de'i skyon gyis// spros bral don yang khong du mi chud pas// ne tso'i chos bshad ji bzhin 'bras bu med/ 5 /bskyed rim dag ni yongs su grub ces pa// rang gi sems kyi gsal stong cha las ni// lha dag yab yum phung khams skye mched dang*// tshigs rtsa nyon mongs las ni sangs rgyas dag /yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo yang*// pho mor bcas pa gdod nas grub pa ste// kun spyod rgyud kyi le'u bcu gnyis par// 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltar snang*// gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu nyid las du ma'i brdar mdzad do// gsungs pas gdod nas grub pa'i lha de nyid// slar yang des bskyed gsal btab grub pa'i gnad/

6 /rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga ni// gal che gsungs pa tshogs bsag las 'phro ldan// sbyang stobs can 'gar ting 'dzin rang shugs skye// de la smin grol lam dag ma bstan na// bar gcod rkyen dang lha sngags sogs med pas| |rnam dag lam mam log pa'i lam chen du// gar 'gro cha med de bas de dag la// so thar sdom dang byang sems sngags kyi lam// brten nas ting nge 'dzin de ngo sprad na// mchog tu 'gyur ba dgongs pa'i gnad zab bo/ 7 /lha rnams thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang*// ldan zhes gsungs pa tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// bral dang rnam smin yon tan kun rdzogs pas// chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bstan pa// mtshan dpe ldan las gzhan du ci zhig 'gyur// dam pa dang po'i lung gi don bsdus pa// rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po mtshan so gnyis// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'di dag ni// ma lus lus la rdzogs pa khyab bdag che// mchog gi go 'phang sngags pas sgrub ces gsungs// des na lha kun mtshan dpe rdzogs na yang*// dus kyi 'khor lo khyung khra'i skur bstan dang*// 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma he'i zhal la sogs// sna tshogs cho 'phrul zlos gar sprul pa'i sku| |mtshan dpe bye ba'i gzi brjid ldan pa nyid/ 8 /lha la sogs pa mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa// gtso bor bya zhes gsungs pa rgyal ba las// mkhas pa'i skye bo gang du'ang med pa'i phyir| |rgyal gsung dri bral mdo dang rgyud rnams nas// gsungs pa'i lha nyid gtso bor bya dgos kyi// nyams dang rmi lam 'khrul blos bslad pa yi// gang dran cho rol can la yid brtan bral| |de yang dga' ldan gnas bzhugs ma pham pas// rgyal las ches mkhas med phyir kun mkhyen gyis// gsungs pa dkrug la chos nyes lci bar gsungs/ 9 /dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa ni// thams cad lhag par dgos zhes gsungs pa yang*// dbang rnon dag la de 'bras yon tan ni// bsam mi khyab pa 'byung sogs la dgongs shing*// blo dman 'bring dang chen po gang la yang*// cho ga tshang ba dgos don rmad byung zhing*// lhag par rab la cho ga rgyas pa yis// lam gyi rtsa ba ma 'khrul dag pa sogs// dgos pa mtha' yas gzigs phyir de ltar gsungs/

10 /spros pa thams cad babs kyi rten 'brel gyis// 'byung zhes gsungs pa chos kun gshis sam babs// de las brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang*// phyi nang gzhan gsum gcig pa gsang sngags kyi// khyad chos rmad byung de yi spros pa ni// rten dang brten bcas dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa// rnam grangs rgyas bsdus ji ltar ci bshad kyang*// phyi nang gzhan gsum gshis babs gcig pa'i phyir// de yi spros pa kun kyang de dag gi// rten cing 'brel 'byung las yin gzhan bcos min/ 11 /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs 'di dag ni| |zab mo'i 'khor lo bya ba gsungs pa yang*// sra ba la sogs rgyu mtshan bdun dag gis// stong nyid rdo rje zhes btags lus la yang*// rdo rje'i sgra sbyar zab mo'i 'khor lo ni// theg pa gzhan du lus sogs mi gtsang rdzas/ /sngags su rtsa rlung thig le sku gsung thugs/ /sku gsum gdod nas grub cing rgyun mi 'chad/ /de phyir zab mo'i 'khor lo zhes su gsungs| 12 |gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gis sbas// zhes pa snod min la sogs gsang phyir dang*// dpe mthong tsam gyis nyams len gzhan la ston// de 'dra'i chos dang gang zag gzu lum can// de la gsang dang rdo rje slob dpon la// ltos phyir sbas la de yang nyams len chos// tshig tu sbas kyi don la sbas pa med// 'bras bu 'di 'byung 'ga' zhig sbas pa yin/ 13 /'dug tshul dang ni las 'ga' sman zab gsungs// lus 'di dang po chags dang bar du gnas// tha mar 'jig dang rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad| |gang yang sngags dang mthun la de nyid las// gsal bar gsungs shing chags gnas 'jig pa'i tshe// nyes gsum 'khrugs dang ma 'khrugs la sogs pa// gshis babs las gzhan ma gsungs de yi phyir// 'ga' zhig gso rig gzhung lugs zab par dgongs/ 14 /gzhan gyi zab pa mi zab de dag gi// mi zab par 'dod rnams ni 'dir zab pa// rgyu ma bsgrub par 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// 'chi 'pho la sogs thun mong chos rnams dang*// nyan rang theg pa dman las theg chen zab// de las 'bras bu'i theg pa zab bya ba// rmang rdo med pa'i mkhar gyi ba gam 'dra// smin grol la ni byang sems rten dgos la// de la'ang so thar ris bdun gang rung ngam// tha na'ang skyabs 'gro sngon du ma song ba'i// mdo sngags lam gyi go chod ci la 'byung*// de dag kun la dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing*// de nyid 'jig sla bde sdug 'bras bu ni// dkar nag las yin 'khor ba'i nyes pa dang*// thar pa'i phan yon snying nas ma bsam pa'i// chos pa de ko da lta'i chos byed bzhin// kha nas chos smra lag tu mi dge spyod// las 'bras khyad du gsod pa 'di ci ga

15 /mi zab pa yi gdams ngag med gyur na| |zab mo rtsa rlung gis 'tshang mi rgya zhes// 'di yang gong ma'i 'phros te 'khor lo gsum// snga phyi rim can lam la ltos pa'i phyir// bden bzhi phar phyin nges don spros bral dang*| |bskyed rim rdzogs rim steng 'og rnam grol sgo// skas kyi gdang bu ji bzhin rim can du// nyams su ma blang rtsa rlung thig le nyid// chags sogs lam la thog mar skad cig la| |'jug pa rdzogs byang thob pa lta zhog gi// gnas skabs zhi bde'i 'bras bu'ang mi 'byung ste// ji ltar zhe na da lta'i rtogs ldan pa// chags lam spyad rnams srid pa kun spel nas| |bza' tshang khyur longs ngu 'bod dmyal ba'i gnas// 'bad pas nyo ba 'di rnams ma mthong ngam/ 16 /bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyams myong log rtog yin// gsungs pa shes bya'i gnas kun ji snyed pa// ji lta 'khrul bral mkhyen pa'i ston pa des// gsungs pa'i gnas las zab pa'i nyams myong ni// dus mtha'i chos byed phal gyis nyams su myong*// de yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab las gsungs pa'i// tshul 'di hang tsam gnad du mi phebs te// de bas nga'am nga yi rmi lam mam// nga yi a pha sogs kyi nyams myong gnad| |gsung rab dag dang mthun par ma gyur kyang*// gnad 'di ldan na mi 'byung dgu 'byung zhes// rang nyid log 'khrul lam du zhugs zin nas// gzhan yang lam der 'khrid pa deng sang mang*/ 17 /bka' yi dgongs pa kun dang 'gal med du// 'gro dgos bya ba gang zag gcig gi ni// rgyud kyi nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams// spong ba'i thabs su chos phung brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa 'khor lo gsum dang ni// rgyud sogs thams cad 'di dgos 'di mi dgos// dbye gdam med pa kun tshang gnad du zab// de phyir bka' dang bstan bcos man ngag kun// nang 'gal med pa don gcig thog 'bab pas// kun kyang rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun pa gces/

18 /gdams ngag ltar du mi 'ong bka' ltar 'ong*// gsungs pa bka' dang gdams ngag mi 'gal na// gang ltar nyams su blangs kyang 'bras 'byung la// de dag 'gal na gdams ngag dor bya nyid// bka' bzhin nyams blang bslu ba ga la srid| |dper na bka' nas chos kun babs bstan pas// rlan gsher dgos na chu la tsha sreg gi// bya ba byed na me nyi dgos pa la// gdams ngag mkhan pos sngags rdzas sbyor ba yis| |chu dgos tshe na me dang me dgos tshe// chu khyer na yang de las des mi byed// de lta'i mngon sum gnad 'dis rtogs par byos/ 19 /skyon med kyi ni ting nge 'dzin gsum po| |khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu zhes gsungs pa ni// bde gsal mi rtog skyon med ting 'dzinagasum// ting 'dzin go chod dag tu bzhed pa rnams// sems kyi ngo bo bde la gsal ba dang*| |mi rtog par ldan chos sku 'di yin lo// de dag gsum la 'dzin stangs blos bkal zhing*// zhen pas bde bas 'dod khams gsal ba yis// gzugs khams mi rtog pa yis gzugs med khams// de der gol gyi gnas lugs ci phyir rtogs// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung gi don// bde gsal rgya mtshor zhen 'dzin nor bu gnas// de la zhen na dug sbrul lta bu yi// dmyal srung dag gis bde chen srog 'phrog cing*// nyam nga'i g.yang skyur de bas der chags spang*// sems nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas su rtogs pa bsgom| |zhes sogs nges don gzhung mang dag tu gsungs/ 20 /sku gsum re re'ang gsum ga'i bdag nyid ces// gsungs pa sems nyid ngo bo stong pa ni// chos sku de'i gdangs 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// rig rtsal sna tshogs sprul sku las gzhan min// de nyid phyi nang gzhan gsum la yang sbyar/ 21 /sngags la tshul khrims med ka med gsungs pa// rgyud kyi nyon rags 'dul khrims kyis spong la// de las phra ba byang sems sdom pas spong*// shin tu phra ba sngags kyis spong ba ste// dus 'khor rgyud las dri ma 'khru ba'i dpe// chen por 'bad chung 'bring po 'bring gis te// chung ngu 'bad pa chen pos 'khru ltar gsungs// a ti shas kyang tshul khrims 'chal ba yis// sngags mi 'grub gsungs des na deng sang gi// sngags pa kun gyis so thar khyad du gsod// sngags lam yin zhes myos 'gyur bde ba mo// nyin mtshan kun tu lam gyi snying por byed// phyi ma de 'bras ci 'dra e ma 'jigs/

22 /'dod pas bar gcod steng du gcig gsungs pa// so thar mdo ru gso sman gnas mal sogs// 'dod yon gang yang ngal dub bsod nyams kyi// mtha' gnyis spangs nas spyod par gsungs pa dang*| |byang sems skabs su mdo las byang sems kyis// chos kun sgyu ma dang 'drar dmigs pa na// 'dod yon spyad kyang nyes med nyid du gsungs// sngags su 'dod yon gtso bo zhu bde yang*// chags bcas zag pas gos na dmyal 'gro zhes// gang yang chags zhen med cing ma 'bad par// chos ldan gyis rnyed nyes med de las gzhan// 'bad cing bsgrub na bar gcod rgyu ru gsungs// deng sang sdom gsum zong gis zang zing sgrub// de 'dra'i mkhan slob rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams// sa steng skye bo'i bsod nams a la la/ 23 /sngags kyi mi dge ba ni dge ba ru// 'gyur ba'i gnas med gsungs pa gzhi lam 'bras// kun kyang rten 'byung 'brel ba babs yin phyir// gcig tu dge ba rnam pa kun tu dge// gcig tu mi dge kun tu dge mi 'gyur// sngags su slob dpon smod pa rtsa ba'i ltung*// byang sar de smad nyes pa lci ba nyid// 'dul bar mkhan slob pha bu ltar bya zhes// gsungs sogs sdom gsum gnad gcig dgongs pa'i gnad// sdom gsum gzhi lam 'bras dus thams cad du// so sor dbye bas sangs rgyas bstan pa phung*/ 24 /'dul bar dge ba sngags su yang dge la// 'dul bar mi dge sngags su mi dge 'gyur// gsungs pa rdor gsung snga ma nyid dang mtshungs// sdom gsum gang la'ang dge sdig spang blang ni// dbye ba med pa thub dbang gnyis pas mkhyen/ 25 /nyon mongs dag 'bras bde bar gshegs pa zhes// gsungs pa nyon mongs can gyi sangs rgyas ni// mi srid de phyir de nyid dag 'bras yin| |mgon po byams pas sems can thams cad ni// sangs rgyas yin yang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas yin par gsungs/

26 /sngags kyi mthu bstan pa las mngon spyod dag /gnang ba med ces gsungs pa 'di lta ste// 'di dang 'di 'dra byas na 'di ltar zhes// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin mthu bshad kyi// de min srog 'phrog ci dgar gnang ba med// zhing bcu las ngan 'phro bcad rdzogs byang du// 'god nus dag gis gzhan don la spyad na// nyes med drag po'i phrin las yin par gsungs// de las gzhan pa bram ze tsa na kya'i// gtam rgyud sogs kyis shes pas spang blang bya// deng sang phyogs re'i ngan sngags gyi na bas// gzhan srog gcod la sngags par rlom rnams kyi// bzhugs gnas rdo rje khab rtse'i zhing khams bzang*/ 27 /rdo rje dmyal ba mnar med yin gsungs pa// mdo nas mnar med sngags su rdo rje dmyal// zhes pa sdug bsngal gyi ming mnar zhes te// mnar ram sdug bsngal de las che med phyir// mnar med ces brjod rdo rje'i sgra sbyar bas// dmyal ba'i nang nas phul du byung bar gtogs/ 28 /rdo rje slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho ba na// de nyid kyis 'dren gsungs pa slob ma yis// dam las 'gal na slob dpon rim gnyis kyi// rtogs pa thob pas skad gcig la 'dren te// dan 'bag dang ni thar pa nag po'i dpe// yang na byang sems nyi ma'i snying po yi// dpe ltar rtogs sla 'on kyang deng sang dus// slob ma dam dral dmyal bar byon mang la// slob dpon rim gnyis drod thob nyin skar tsam// de bas gzab par bya'o shes ldan rnams// gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms lnga pa'o/// / ༈ 1 /brgyud pa nas ni brgyud pa'i chos zab cing*// ngo mtshar ba yin bya ba gsungs pa ni// chos kun lung dang bcas pa lung dag kyang*// man ngag dang bcas de yang brgyud par bcas/ brgyud pa dag kyang byin rlabs ldan pa dgos| |ye shes thig le'i lung don 'di lta ste// cho ga thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur ni// man ngag de nyid dang ni bcas pa ste// de yang gcig nas gcig tu rim par brgyud| |bla ma rab kyi zhal nas blang bar gsungs// mnga' bdag mai tri pa yi gsung gi don// bla ma'i man ngag gnad kyis ma brgyan na// dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam du zad ces gsungs| |'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po'i lung gi don// gzhon nu bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha la rag las na// ting nge 'dzin 'di lta ci smos zhes gsungs|

2 |'khor 'das kyis bsdus chos rnams thams cad ni// rang gi sems yin gsungs pa yum gyi mdor// khams gsum po ni sems tsam zhes gsungs dang*// rgyal tshab dam pa mgon po ma pham pas// sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// zhes dang gzhan yang 'di ltar gsungs pa ste// sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mtha' dag ster ba yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs gsungs kyang spros pa de tsam mo/ 3 /chos rnams thams cad bsam pa skad cig ma'i// rang gzugs yin zhes gsungs pa gang zhe na// zhi lha'i spyod 'jug lung don smos pa ni// lcags sreg sa gzhi sus byas mo tshogs dag |gang las byung na de kun sdig sems las// byung zhes gsungs dang nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor// su zhig tha ma 'chi tshe gnod sems byung*// rtag tu phrag dog ser snas khros pa la| |bsam gtan mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pas min// tshul khrims mi skyob dgon par gnas pas min// zhes pa mi dge'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs te// des 'gre dge ba'i bsam pa skad cig ma'i// rang gzugs kyang ni 'byung ba gshis babs yin/ 4 /gshis la mi gnas na ni bltas pa yis// mi 'gyur bya ba nam mkha'i gshis la ni// sra brtan med pas der bltas der mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin sa la go 'byed gshis med pas/ /nam mkhar bltas kyang de der ci phyir 'gyur/ /'di yang gshis babs gnas lugs bstan par mtshungs/ 5 /mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla ma yis// yon tan skyed par mi nus zhes gsungs pa// ji ltar yi ge med pa'i par shing la// tshon snag shog bu glan yang shing leb mo'i// rjes las yi ge'i tshogs pa mi 'byung ltar// mtshan nyid mi ldan bla ma bsten byas nas// mnyes pa bsgrubs kyang de la de med phyir// slob ma la yang yon tan ci phyir 'byung*// de bas 'dul ba mdo dang rgyud rnams su// thog mar bla ma'i yon tan gal cher gsungs/

6 /rtogs pa bskyed thabs mos gus kho nar nges// zhes gsungs pa yang byams mgon lung bsdu na// rang byung rnams kyi don dam rtogs pa'i thabs// dad pa nyid yin gsungs dang gshed skor gyi// rgyud rnams su ni dad pa sangs rgyas la// dad pa chos la dad pa dge 'dun yin// dad pa pha yin dad pa ma yin sogs// rgya cher gsungs kyi de don go bar sla/ 7 /lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa gsungs pa// phyi nang lta ba thams cad spros dang bcas// blo yi bye brag 'dzin stangs 'khrul ba'i yid// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i zhal nas kyang*// nga la lta ba med ces gsungs pa yang*// blos byas 'dzin stangs 'khrul ba de la dgongs// 'khor 'das chos kun rang sems nyid rtogs shing*// sems nyid chos sku mtha' bral rtogs pa na// gnas lugs don gyi lta ba de nyid yin// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab ma pham byams mgon gyis// sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig na// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes gsungs phyir na spros bral chos dbyings la// spros bcas lta ba'i tshig bshad rtog ge'i ngag /rtag chad mu la 'byon pa 'o re brgyal/ 8 /chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa// zhes pa dbu ma chen po mtha' thams cad// dang bral zhes kyang 'dzin stangs blos ma thong*// phyag rgya chen po chos kun dngos po ni// gshis kyi gnas lugs zer yang gtad so bral// rdzogs pa chen po spros bral khas blangs kyang*// stong pa'i gzugs la zhen pa'i skyon dang bcas// sgra gcan 'dzin gyis yum la bstod pa las// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum zhes gsungs pa ste// brjod dang blos btags bsam dang dran dpyad sogs// spros kun bral ba chen gsum 'dzin grol mchog

/la las khyod kyi dkar po chig thub la// sems bskyed bsngo ba dgos na gsum du 'gyur// zhes sogs smra yang chig thub rgyal ba 'dis// lhag par rtsal 'don bzhed pa min na yang*// snyi sgom la sogs gong mas bzhed pa'i don// gtso che mtshan don dgongs kyi yan lag min// yang na khong gi lam 'bras brjod bya yi// gzhi med pa la lam dang 'bras bu ci// de sogs klan ka khyod la cis mi 'bab/ 9 /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi ni stong nyid de// shor gol yin zhes gsungs pa ji skad du// phra phyir thos pa'i yul min don dam phyir// bsam pas min la chos nyid zab pa'i phyir// 'jig rten sgom pa dag gis mi rtogs gsungs// de phyir thos bsam sgom pa tsam po ba'i// go yul stong nyid shor gol las gzhan med/ 10 /rtogs pa goms par byed pa sgom pa zhes// gsungs don sgom pa zhes pa gzhan med de// sems nyid lhan skyes chos skur ngo sprad pa'i// rgyun la yeng med goms par byas pa la// sgom pa zhes btags de min mig hrig hrig /skyil krung mnyam bzhag sems la kha ma reg /de 'dra de la sgom zhes 'dir mi 'dod/ 11 /spyod pa blang dor dang ni bral ba de// tshul khrims rin po che yin gsungs pa ni// khyim spang nges par 'byung bar khas blangs nas// 'dod pa sgrub cing mi 'dod phyogs spong la// gang yang khyim pa ji lta de lta min/ /mtha' gnyis spang ba'i spyod pa la slob pa/ /blang dor bral ba'i snying po de yin la| |dge sdig blang dor med par dgongs pa min/ 12 /lta sgom spyod gsum gcig pa yin gsungs pa// lta ba rtogs par ldan zhing de nyid sgom// de dang mi 'gal legs par spyod pa la| |dgongs kyi deng sang lta ba rang gzhan gyis// stong sogs spros med spros pas 'chad bzhin du// sgom pa sna tshogs spyod pa brlang po yis// don gnyis 'grub pa nub nas nyi 'char bzhin/

13 /phyag rgya che dang tshul khrims gcig pa ni// 'jig rten mgon po'i khyad chos bla med yin// gsungs pa tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gzhir// khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin par gsungs// zhes pa'i kun sgras phyag rgya che sogs bsdus// sdig spong dge sgrub gnad kyis kyang gcig la// sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam rig min gzugs ni// phyag rgya che dang don gcig ming tha dad// nges 'byung zhes pa lhag med myang 'das dag /yin par slob dpon chos bshes zhes pa yang*| |phyag rgya che dang mi gcig sems yin no// 'phags pa ting 'dzin rgyal po las gsungs pa// ting 'dzin rgyal po stong pa 'di bsgoms pas// tshul khrims dag pa'i mgo la de 'dug ste// chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa mnyam bzhag nas// byis pas mi rig brtson pas mi shes so// zhes gsungs 'dul mdor shes gtso zhes pa dang*// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul ba 'di// sangs rgyas bstan pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang*// yid kyi me dge ba dag mi byed cing*// zhes sogs sems gtsor gsungs pas kyang ni gcig /gzhan yang mtshungs dang 'brel bar byed las dang*// gshis gcig pas kyang phyag tshul nges par gcig /14 /phyag rgya chen po yon tan thams cad kyi// bdag nyid ces gsungs gzhi lam 'bras kun tu// phyag rgya chen po yon tan kun bdag nyid// gtso bor phyi nang gzhan gsum gcig pa dang*// gshis sam babs sogs rgyal gsung kun gyi don// phyi yi nam mkha' kun gyi go 'byed pas// sa chu me rlung snod bcud kun brten cing*// kun gyi gzhir gyur ji bzhin bde gshegs khams// spros dang bral ba chos sku'i yon tan dang*// mdzad pa bcas pa de yi yon tan yin/ 15 /mnyam par bzhag las yon tan thams cad ni// 'byung ba yin zhes sdud pa'i lung gi don// bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan dag

/smad par 'dod dang rigs dang mngon shes dang*// ting 'dzin mngon grub ces dang zhi ba lhas// zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms zhes gsungs pa dang*// chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo lung don// yid ni mnyam par bzhag las yang dag pa// ji bzhin mthong bar 'gyur ba de yis ni// byang sems sems can rnams la snying rje 'jug /ces dang mdo sde rgyan gyi lung bsdus pa// bsam gtan des kyang skye ba thams cad pa// byang chub rnam pa gsum la 'god ces gsungs/ 16 /rgyu ma bsgrub par yon tan thams cad ni// mi 'byung bya ba ma skyes dgra yi ni// 'gyod pa bsal mdo'i lung gi don bshad ltar// chos kun rgyu yi rjes su 'gro ba ste// rkyen la rag las sred pa'i rtsa ba can// smon lam gyis ni thog drangs pa'o gsungs// rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das// zhes sogs rgyu las 'bras 'byung gshis sam babs// mnyam par bzhag las yon tan 'byung ba dang*| |rgyu med 'bras bu mi 'byung mi 'gal te/ 17 /stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rgyu 'bras su// 'byung zhes gsungs pa khyad chos rnam dag ste// 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdor| |chos nyid las kyi rnam smin med shes kyang*// dge dang mi dge'i las ni chud mi 'dza'// zhi bar gnas pa'i rang rgyal theg pa de// nyan thos rnam par grol ba'i sgra phyir 'brang*| |zhes dang rje btsun mi las sgam po par// yar ni sangs rgyas dag la mi re yang*// dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun mi 'chad la 'bad// ngan song dag la mar ni dogs med kyang*| |sdig pa phra zhing phra la 'dzem zhes gsungs// de phyir stong nyid rtogs zhes bya ba'i don// chos kun gnas lugs gshis sam babs yin la/ gshis ni ngo bo stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid| |babs ni gang du'ang grub pa med pa ste/ /de don rtogs la stong nyid rtogs zhes bya/

/gshis babs rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bas na// de rtogs de nyid de yi tshul du 'byung*| 18 |rtogs ldan la ni thabs lam la sogs pa// lhag par dgos gsungs gnas lugs rtogs pa la// rang gzhan don bsgrub slad du gtum mo sogs// thabs lam gnad rnams la sbyangs gegs sel dang*// bogs 'don phyir na de dag lhag par dgos/ 19 /tshul khrims la ni gces spras byed pa dag /rigs spyod khyad par du 'phags zhes gsungs pa| |nyon mongs brtul nas ye shes stobs zhugs pa// brtul zhugs mchog yin rgyal bas gsungs pa'i phyir// tshul khrims ma smad bsrung ba brtul zhugs mchog /khrims nyams bag med smyon pa ltar spyod pa// thar lam brtul nas ngan 'gro la zhugs pa'i// rgab rdum rbad mgo'i brtul zhugs 'dir ci bya// rigs pa'i spyod pa bag yod la dgongs kyi// mi rigs spyod ces de las ldog pa yin/ 20 /bhu su ku yang chos gsum med na ni// zhi ba nyan rang yin zhes gsungs pa yang*// gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sgom chen sgrub la brtson// za nyal bshang ba'i 'du shes gsum ma gtogs// rnam rtog mi mnga' mnyam bzhag dus 'da' yang*// nyes pa nyes par mthong ba'i nges shes dang*// yon tan dgos par go ba'i sgrub pa dang*// snying brtser ldan pa'i gzhan phan gsum med na// theg chen khyu nas bud pa'i nyan rang yin// de phyir de gsum chos rnams kun la gces// khyad par lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms drug pa'o/// / ༈ 1 /sangs rgyas sar ni bden pa gnyis su med// gsungs pa lung don gyis bshad 'di lta ste// nyon mongs ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*// ye shes snang ba rgyas phyir sangs rgyas zhes// sangs rgyas pad+ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas// zhes pas nyon mongs spangs shing ye shes dag /rgyas pa de la yod med gnyis 'dzin pa'i// kun rdzob don dam dbye ba nges yod na// rgyal la bden rdzun gnyis ka yod pa'i phyir// so so'i skye bo rnams dang khyad ci mchis/

2 /ye shes dag ni gnyis su med pa yi// ye shes kho na bya ba ye gdod ma'i// shes pa rang ngo 'phrod cing byang chub pas// sa lam rdzogs la sangs rgyas zhes btags pa'i// thugs kyi ye shes ji lta ji snyed dag /mkhyen la yod dang med ces su yis spobs// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lung don 'di lta ste// gnyis su med dang gnyis med don zhes dang*// gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang rnam shes kyi// chos nyid 'das zhes gsungs pa kho nar nges/ 3 /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag par// 'das zhes gsungs pa mgon po byams pa yi// rgyud bla'i lung don 'dus ma byas pa dang*// lhun gyis grub dang gzhan rkyen gyis mi rtogs// zhes pa'i 'dus ma byas pas mi rtag min// lhun gyis grub pas glo bur bcos min la// gzhan rkyen mi rtogs rang don chos gsum gsungs| |sgyu ma rdzas sngags 'du byas mi rtag 'jig /skyes bus sprul pas lhun gyis ci phyir grub// sgyu ma mkhan gyis byas pas gzhan rkyen nyid// de phyir de dang de dag ga la mtshungs| 4 |sangs rgyas dus rnams rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs// zhes pa phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud dag las// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi tshad ma// zhes dang phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang ni// gser 'od dag las tshad mar gyur pa zhes// gsungs pa la sogs des na sangs rgyas la// tshad ma min zhes nang pa su yis gleng*/ 5 /bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi thugs can// gsungs pa nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral 'bras kyis// shes bya ji lta ji snyed mkhyen cing gzigs// de dag ye shes las gzhan nyon mongs med// rnam rtog la sogs 'khrul ba'i blo bral te// slob dpon chen po dpa' bos 'di skad gsungs// rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen// zhes pa rnam rtog 'khrul snang med na yang*// sngon gnas gsung dang gzhan gang lung ston pa// ye shes dag pa'i snang ba yod pa'i phyir// ye shes snang ba lam me ba zhes gsungs/

6 /chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa// zhes gsungs pa ni sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// 'khrul ba mi mnga' la sogs chos bco brgyad// mnga' ba de las longs sku nges pa lnga// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan der snang zhing*// de las gzhan ngor sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// 'char ba chos sku'i yon tan mdzad pa ste// byang sems spyod yul thabs kyi rnam 'phrul mdor// bsod nams brgya yis mtshan dang ldan pas na// lhar bcas 'jig rten nang na bsod nams gter// mthong ngam thos sam gzhes par mdzad pas kyang*// sems can kun la phan par mdzad pa lags// chos sku nam mkha' ltar rtogs yon tan dang*// mdzad pa med na ci'i phyir sangs rgyas zhes/ 7 /sangs rgyas kyi ni sa na thugs bskyed yod// bya ba rdzogs sangs rgyas ni byang sems kyi// sems las 'khrungs pas mthar thug de la yang*// gang 'dul thabs kyis thugs bskyed rgyun mi 'chad// mgon po byams pa'i lung gi don bsdu na// sems can kun gyi bya bar khyod dag ni| |dus las mi 'da' mdzad pa rtag tu ni// don mnga' zhes dang 'jig rten kun la ni// nyin mtshan lan drug so sor gzigs nas ni// thugs rje che ldan phan dgongs zhes gsungs dang*| |sgra brnyan chu bo sprin gsum sangs rgyas sa'i// thugs bskyed dper bzhag de phyir de nyid yod/ 8 /thugs gcig pu yang rtag chad kyi lta ba// tshun chad du 'byung gsungs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// thams cad mkhyen pas shes bya'i chos mchog dman// ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i spros bral gyi// ngo bor bzhugs pa'i ye shes thugs gcig pu// rnam pa sna tshogs gdul bya'i blo ngor ni// ngan pa rtag chad lta ba tshun la 'jug /de lta min na thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan// don dang dngos 'gal gsang bsam la sogs don// sangs rgyas kyi thugs sems kyi dmigs pa ni// kun kyang bral la sems can thams cad kyi// sems kyi spyod pa dang ni bsam pa yang*// rab tu shes so zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/

9 /shes bya la ni srid tshad ma lus pas// sangs rgyas dag gi bya ba byed gsungs pa// shes byar srid pa'i chos dang chos can kun// rang gi babs sam gshis las mi 'da' ba| |rgyu las 'bras 'byung tshur mthong byis blos kyang*// shes par nus pa rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di// las 'bras mngon ston sangs rgyas bya ba yin// bdud dang log par 'dren pa'ang de lta ste// dri med grags pas bstan pa'i mdo lung don// dga' bo bdud bzhi po dang nyon mongs pa// stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi de dag gis// sems can kun nas gdung byed yin mod kyang*// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams de dag gis// sangs rgyas kyis ni bya ba byed do gsungs// gzhung du dus la bab na zhes gsungs mod// dus la bab na lta ci smos 'tshal te/ */dus la ma bab na yang dus kun tu// rgyu las 'bras 'byung zhing pa'i so nam dang*// gshis babs bstan pa 'byung bzhi rang rang gi/ */gshis las mi 'da' go log 'byung min ltos| |rgyu 'bras gshis babs gsal por ston pa 'di// sangs rgyas rnams kyi bya ba yin pas so// rgyal ba rnams la de las gzhan pa yi// chos gzhan yod na smros shig bod rgan rnams| 10 |chos dbyings kun tu rdzogs sangs ma rgyas na// sangs rgyas dag tu mi 'gyur bya ba'i don// chos kyi dbyings ni rigs khams bde gshegs snying*// sems can rnams kyi khams rgyud ming yin la// de don rtogs pa bla med byang chub ste// de ni bsam mi khyab pa'i spyod yul te// chos dbyings gcig nyid kun gyi chos dbyings te// de phyir de sangs rgyas pa yongs khyab phyir// mdo lung don bsdus tshigs bcad 'di skad smra// tshangs pa nga ni yongs su chad pa yi// rnam pas tshad dang ldan par sangs ma rgyas// nga ni tshad med ris su ma chad pa'i| |rnam pas chos kun mnyam pa nyid dag tu// mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes gsungs phyir/

11 /rgyu med sprul pa mi srid rang rgyud pa// gsungs don rgyal ba'i sprul pa mchog dman kun// rgyu med ma yin rgyu dang bcas pa ste// sprul pa mchog dman thams cad rgyur bstan pas// rang rgyud pa ste yum don 'dir bsdus pa// rab 'byor chos rnams thams cad sprul pa ste// kha cig nyon mongs sprul pa kha cig ni// las kyi sprul pa kha cig nyan thos kyi// sprul pa'o kha cig rang rgyal sprul pa ste// la la rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'o// gsungs phyir dman pa'i sprul pa'ang rgyu dang bcas// rang rgyud pa yin des na skyon dag cing*// yon tan ma lus rab tu rdzogs pa yi// mchog gi sprul par rgyu med mi srid pas// rang rgyud pa las gzhan du 'gyur mi srid/ 12 /sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi ni sku can yin// gsungs pa gdul bya'i mos blor snang ba ste// ma pham rgyal bas rgyud bla'i gzhung nyid du// ji ltar baiḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// zhes gsungs dper na skyes bu'i gdong chos sku// me long g.ya' bral 'gro ba'i blo ngo nyid// de'i gdong ngo shar mchog dman sprul skur mtshungs// lung dang dpe 'dis ma rtogs ches blun no/ 13 /smon pa las ni longs sku 'jug pa la// sprul sku yang 'byung zhes gsungs 'di lta ste// smon sems 'gro kun don bskyed mtha' yas las| |longs sku zhing sogs mtha' yas de thob la// smon las 'jug sems bskyed pas sprul pa'i sku// gang 'dul skur ston 'byung la yang gi sgras// smon pas sprul sku 'jug pas longs sku ni// 'byung ba'ang mtha' gcig mi dgag gnyis ka gzung*/ 14 /sku gsum tha dad med par bzhugs bya ba// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa phar phyin bzhi// ldan pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku de nyid ni// ngo bo rigs khams glo bur dri ma dag

/bsal ba'i ming yin de yi yon tan dang*// mdzad pa longs sprul mchog dman kun 'byung ba// nyi las zer dang chu zla la sogs pa// rnam grangs du ma'i dpes mtshon rtogs par sla/ 14 /sangs rgyas thams cad sems can gyi khams rgyud// dag la bzhugs zhes gsungs pa sngags gzhung du// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs sogs gang gsungs pa// sems can rnams kyi khams yin de las gzhan// sangs rgyas rnams la yul gyi bdag 'dzin med// rgyud bla'i lung don rdzogs sangs rgyas sku ni// 'phro ba'i phyir dang de bzhin nyid khams la// dbyer med rigs yod rgyu mtshan de gsum phyir// 'gro kun rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs zhes gsungs// mya ngan 'das pa zhes kyang gzhan med de// mdo lung rnams su 'khor ba dang myang 'das// gnyis su med kyi 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ni// shes la mya ngan 'das zhes brjod par gsungs// de phyir sangs rgyas zhes pa bzang po gang*// dag pa'i zhing du bzhugs kyi sems can zhes| |ngan pa tha chad 'khor bar 'khyams pa skad// gnyis 'dzin blo 'dis thog mtha' kun tu phung*// 'khor 'das dbyer med rang sems sangs rgyas dngos// 'gro ba kun kyang de dang mtshungs rtogs pa'i// don dam nges pa'i blo ldan de 'tshang rgya// 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i gnad bsdus pa ste tshoms bdun pa'o/// / ༈ 1 /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi ni rgyal ba rnams| |bstan pa gcig ces gsungs pa mtshungs pa bzhi// yi ge gsung chos sku dang bzhi la dgongs// lang gshegs mdo lung bsdus pa 'di lta ste// blo gros chen po de bzhin gshegs rnams ni// mtshungs pa bzhi la dgongs zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 2 /theg pa dang ni grub mtha' thams cad pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel yin gsungs pa// slob dpon 'phags pa'i gsung gi don bsdus pa// rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs chos gzhan med// ces gsungs phyir na spros pa mang pos ci/

3 /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams| |nyon mongs gnyen por gsungs pa 'di lta ste// rnam snang mngon byang rgyud lung don bsdu na// nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por chos phung ni// brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs zhes bya bar bshad/ 4 /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis gsungs rnams ni// gcig gi nang du bcu gnyis po thams cad// ci rigs su ni tshang zhes gsungs pa ni// bskal bzang mdo ru tshigs bcad mang po rnams/ /gsungs pa tshigs bcad ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rnams/ /'byung bar gsungs rnams lung bstan sde yin la/ /de sogs gzhan du mang yang shes par sla/ 5 /sde snod re re bzhin du sde snod dag /gsum char 'dus gsungs 'di nyid rtsa tshig tu// ma 'thus na yang 'khor lo rnam gsum du// 'dres can kho na gsungs pa sdud pa pos| |rtogs par sla phyir so sor bsdus na yang*// da dung tshig don 'dres can tshang bar bzhugs/ 6 /'khor 'das thams cad phun tshogs lngas bsdus pa// 'jig rten mgon po'i khyad chos bla med 'di// don la 'khor 'das dbye ba med pa yang*// rang bzhin rtogs dang ma rtogs yin par bzhed// brtag gnyis rgyud don 'chad pa po nga la// rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga la sogs// gsungs shing myang 'das phun tshogs lnga mthun yang*// dmyal sogs phun tshogs lnga yang de rang gi// gtso bo ston pa 'khor dus gnas la sogs// de nyid gzhir bzhag chos ni rang rang gi// las 'bras sdug bsngal dag la longs spyod pa// rgyu 'bras gshis babs mngon sum ston pa de// chos kyi gtso bo yin mod rgyal bas ni// rgyu 'bras chos gsungs dmyal sogs rgyu 'bras la// dngos su spyod pa dam pa'i chos ston yin/ 7 /thun mong mdo dang sems tsam ston pa'i bka'// mngon pa'i sde snod nyid du bzhed pa ni// bden bzhi 'dul ba bar pa mdo sde la// tha ma mngon pa gong 'og gnyis las ni// phal po che sogs sems tsam mdo bzhi la// sor phreng pad dkar la sogs nges don mdo// mang po bsdu zhing 'og ma sde bdun khongs// thun mong mdo sogs sdud pas de skad gsungs/

8 /mu stegs dang ni bon gyi sgor zhugs pas// bden pa mthong ba'i gnas med gsungs pa ni// log lta can gyis bden pa ci phyir mthong*// gang zag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang*// thams cad rnam par smin pa mi bzad ldan// gsungs phyir phyi rol pa yis bden mi mthong*// bon yang log par thal bas de khongs bsdu/ 9 /thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni// yod par mi 'gal gsungs pa cha mthun gyi// dge ba snying rje che sogs gsungs pa dang*// bon la'ang sbyin sogs 'ga' zhig yod pas so/ 10 /sdom pa srung dang snying rje phyi rol pa// dag la'ang yod ces bya ba 'di lta ste// dge bcur 'bad dang snying rje che ba dang*// 'dod yon spong dang dka' thub la gzhol ba// phyi rol pa rnams brtson pa che bar grags/ 11 /mtshan nyid theg pas kyang ni tshe gcig gis// 'tshang rgyar bzhed pa brtson dang mtshungs/ 12 /chos dang nyams len 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig /gsungs pa mdo sngags gang gi sangs rgyas kyang*// rgyu ru tshogs bsags lam dus sgrib pa sbyangs// 'bras bu sangs rgyas don gnyis 'grub pa
