sems sdom pa la// skabs skabs tsag tsig tsam 'ong sngags sdom la// ltung ba chag chig nyag cig 'ong bar gsungs// so thar sdom pas nyon mongs rags pa spong*// byang sems bar ma sngags kyis phra ba kun// gnyen po chung ngu 'bring dang che bas so/ 14 /mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi ni sa tshun chad// tshogs lam dag gi ngo bos bgrod par bzhed// tshogs lam zhes pa spyi dang sgos gnyis te// spyi ni dang po'i lam pa nas bzung ste// rdzogs byang bar du tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i lam// yin phyir de skad sgos ni lam lnga'i mtshan// tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum gsungs de ste// des na mthar thug tshun chad tshogs gnyis po// rdzogs pa'i lam gyi bgrod bya yin par dgongs/

15 /nyan rang dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang*// ldan pas mthar thug byang chub chen por 'gyur| |gsungs pa nyan rang la yang sangs rgyas rgyu// rang bzhin rnam dag khams dang ldan pa'i steng*// tshogs gnyis bsag rung yin pa'i gnad ka dang*// gnas skabs sems bskyed dman pas ring 'gyangs kyang*/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes bskul dang rang nyid kyi/ /las sad pa yis rgyal ba'i yon tan dag /dran nas theg mchog sems bskyed byang chub 'thob| 16 |'khor ba mtha' med spros pa med gsungs pa// 'khor gzhi gdod nas spros bral gshis sam babs// grub pa myong ba rkyen gyis dkrugs pa las// 'khor bar snang bas gshis la mtha' med phyir// 'khor ba la yang mtha' dang spros pa bral/ 17 /chos kun so sor thar pa'i sdom gsum ni// re rer 'du zhes gsungs pa sdom pa gsum// dril na thabs shes gnyis las gzhan med de// so thar bsrung thabs ma lus thabs yin la// ltung ba so sor dbye srung shes rab nyid// byang sems kun rdzob smon pa thabs yin la// der 'jug rnam 'jog dpyad shes shes rab yin// sngags la bskyed rim thabs la rdzogs shes rab// kun kyang srid las so sor thar thabs yin/ 18 /sde pa bzhi char gyi ni rtsa ba nyid// sde bzhi'i lung nyid kho na yin gsungs pa// 'dul mdo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa// sde bzhi las med sde pa bzhi dang ni// bco brgyad gyes pa ston pa 'das pa'i rjes// yin phyir rig pa des grub spros pas ci/ 19 /sgrub par mi nus pa la rmi lam du// nyams kyang 'di la nyes pa 'byung bya ba// gshis dang rgyu rkyen la brten lhag med dang*| |thabs la mkhas pa gsungs pas nyes par 'gyur/ 20 /dag pa'i sa thob kyang ni ngan song du// song ba'ang yod ces gsungs pa las kyis te// chu skyes dpa' byin glang dom spre'u sogs// byang chub sems dpa' ngan 'gror 'gro srid de// las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab// las med na ni skye ba'i mtshams mi sbyor// snying rje'i bdag nyid can yang dud 'gror skye// zhes sogs gsungs pa rgyu 'bras bslu med gshis/

21 /rgyu spyad na ni sa bcu pa dag kyang*// ngan 'gror ltung zhes gsungs pa sa bcu pas// mi dge'i las ngan gsog pa mi srid mod// gal te spyad na rgyu 'bras bden pa'i phyir// ngan 'gror 'gro ba sa bcu'i mngon rtogs kyis// mi khegs rgyu 'bras rten 'byung bden pa'i phyir/ 22 /nyams len rmad byung rnal 'byor nang gi ni// tshogs gsog bya ba zhing bsam dngos dag pa// gal che'i gnad de zang zing dngos po bas// rang lus btang ba ya mtshan rmad byung bas// ku sā li yi gdams pa nyams su blang*// ku sā li zhes dge ba can gyi ming*/ 23 /ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus tshad rdo rje ni// lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin du gcig bya ba// gzhung du med kyang dgongs pa'i gnad 'di ltar// ting 'dzin zhes pa 'khrul blos ma dkrug pa'i// bsam gtan la bzhed de phyir rdo rje'i dpes// gsungs pa 'khrul blos ma bcom sra brtan dgongs/ 24 /sngags ni sde snod gsum ga dag dang ni// gsum char gyi yang snying por bzhed pa ni// sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum zhes pa// thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gsum gyi sgra// gzhan du gsal min zhar la gsungs pa nyid// sngags su gsal gsungs de phyir sde snod kun// gyi ni snying po rdo rje theg pa yin/ 25 /rgyud la skyes kyang brgyud pa'i chos zab pas// cho ga dgos gsungs dbang po rab 'bring tha/ /gang la'ang rang byung ye shes rtogs dka' ba/ /las dang 'phen pas rang gar nyams myong yang*/ /rgyud don las dngos smin grol cho ga dgos| 26 |lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad pa// grub par byed gsungs lha gang yin pa de'i// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga tshang zhing*// phrin las dus la bab na gang 'dul der// ston pa mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ste// bsdu na thugs kyi rigs gcig kho na ste// sngags rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid bde gshegs kyi// thugs la gnas zhes gsal por gsungs pas shes/

27 /lha thams cad kyi mtshan ni lhag pa'i lhas// bzung ba zhes gsungs lhag pa'i lha gang des// rgyu dus nyon mongs lam gyi dus sbyangs nas| |bral 'bras rnam smin yon tan gyi ngo bor// sangs rgyas pa dang mtshan dpe ldan pa sogs// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ma lus pa// mchog dman mi mnga' mnyam zhing de'i mtshan yang*// bcom ldan 'das zhes sgra gcig gsol btab na// rjes 'dzin dngos grub stsol sogs ma lus gcig 28 /dus bzhi rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang ba yi// dus skabs med ces gsungs pa 'khrig pa sogs// rtsa ba'i dam tshig dgos pa skabs don du// gnang ba ye med sher dbang nyams len yang*// yid dang lus rig gang la brten yang rung*// khu ba nyams na bde ba'i rten med la// bde ba med na stong pa'i ye shes kyang*// gshog ya med pa'i 'dab chags 'phur ba bzhin// de med de mi 'byung phyir gnang ba med/ 29 /lha la cig car du ni 'jug pa dag /gnad zab par bzhed bskyed rim yongs grub phyir// rang lus ril po lha dang dbyer med du// thog ma nyid nas sgom pa zab pa'i gnad// rim gyis 'jug pa rtul zhing zab pa min/ 30 /lha ni rten 'brel gyi tshogs pas grub pa// shes dgos gsungs pa yongs grub gzhir bzhag gnad// de yang rten 'brel tshogs pa med mi rung*// phung sogs rgyu la bum dbang de yi rkyen// rgyu rkyen las grub lha de rten 'byung gi// rang gzugs yin par shes pa'i gnad gsum po/ */rten 'brel tshogs pa med ka med pa'i phyir/ 31 /dka' thub la sogs pa ni tha mal gyi// lus su btags pas smad ces gsungs pa yang*// phung khams lha ru yongs grub de mi smad// phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag de smad na// rtsa ltung brgyad pa'i khur gyis 'o re brgyal/ 32 /drang don nges don med par cho ga ni// rgyas pa thams cad la dgos gsungs pa ni// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang 'thob pa la// rgyu rkyen phun tshogs dgos phyir sa chog sogs// dgos chung mi bya rgyud kyi gzhung ltar spyad/

33 /gang gi 'dul ba gtso bor gyur pa la// bsdus par yang bzhed gsungs pa yang gi sgras// dus ni thams cad dag la nges pa gcig /blun 'dzin mi bya gang zag rigs tha dad// phyir na cig car ba la skad cig dang*// rim gyis pa la cho ga'ang go rim bzhin| |dgongs kyang phal cher rim gyis nyid mang bas// cho ga rgyas pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/ 34 /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rmad du byung ba ni// byang chub sems kyi go cha zhes gsungs pa// bris dang bsgoms pa'i mtshon cha'i rwa gur sogs// bcos pas gzung 'dzin bsrung 'khor gyi na tsam// chos kun ngo bos stong pa'i rig pa yis// thams cad grub pa med pa'i stong nyid dang*// 'gro la snying brtse ldan pa'i zung 'jug gi// byang chub sems kyi go cha sra brtan 'dis// byang chub shing drung dpa' bos bdud btul ba'ang*/ */go mtshon 'di yin bris pa'i gzugs brnyan la// srad bus bcings dang bcos mas bsgoms pa yi// rwa gur bsrung ba kun brtags gyi na tsam/ 35 /rtsa rlung gi gnad lhag par yang 'dul ba// che bar gsungs pa rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad// gcun pas dwangs ma 'dzag med bder 'tsho bar// dgongs kyi 'dul bar rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor sogs// tsar tsir mi dgos bag yod la brten pa'i| |khrims kyis dwangs ma 'tsho zhing 'phel ba sogs// gnad mang mchis pas chos 'dul snying ltar gzung*/ 36 /byin rlabs dang ldan pas ni kun gzhi dag /dus gzhan du yang mthong bar gsungs pa ni// sa bcu pas kyang kun gzhi rigs khams dag /mthong bar dka' yang byin ldan bla ma las// dad ldan slob mar man ngag gnad btab pas// rang sems rang ngo 'phrod pa de de nyid// kun gzhi mthong la de yi gdangs rtsal las// rtsa rlung thig le rdo rje'i lus rnams dang*// phyi rol 'byung dang gzhan sems shes la sogs// rang sems mthong bas gzhan kun shes pa ste// mi la'i gsung ltar gcig shes kun grol 'di// phyi nang gzhan gsum gcig pa'i gnad dam pa/

37 /snyigs ma dug bcas kyi ni rtsa rlung dang*| |thig le khyad par du zab ces gsungs pa// rtsa rlung thig le dag par ma byas pas// dug gsum ma dag rgyu der gnad bsnun pas// rdo rje 'dzin grub ma dag snyigs ma ni// de gsum med na sbyang gzhi med pa'i phyir// sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras ri bong rwa ltar 'gyur/ 38 /bslab pa gsum ni gsang sngags rdo rje yi// theg pa'i yang ni lam rim bya ba yang*// rgyud gzhung phal las sdom pa bsgrags 'dzin skabs// tshul khrims don byed chos sdud bslab pa gsum// 'dzin par khas blangs pa des grub pa'i phyir// rgyas bshad ma dgos dngos bstan de las ci/ 39 /phar phyin drug ni theg pa gsum char gyi// lam zhes gsungs pa sbyin tshul khrims bzod gsum// bsod nams tshogs yin bsam shes ye shes tshogs// gnyis ka'i grogs de brtson 'grus yin pa'i phyir// theg gsum lam la phyin drug med ka med/ 40 /dpon slob gnyis kas phan tshun dam tshig ni// mnyam par gcig gsungs pa yang slob ma yis/ /dam 'gal rtsa ltung dang po 'byung 'gyur la/ /bla mas 'das na rtsa ltung bcu gnyis pa/ /'byung phyir mnyam par bag yod kyis 'bad bsrung*| 41 |phyag rgya chen po la ni dge ba yi// ngo bos sgrib mi srid ces gsungs pa yang*// ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa rtogs mi 'gyur| |zhes gsungs phyir na dge ba'i ngo bo des// phyag rgya chen po sgrib pa ga la srid// sgrib pa bas kyang stong nyid rtogs pa dang*// bogs 'don gegs sel 'bras thob myur ba la| |tshogs gnyis bsag pa lam gyi gtso bor gzung*/ 42 /bral 'bras thams cad rgyu dang bcas pa zhes// gsungs pa nyon mongs bral ba'i 'bras bu de// nyon mongs 'bral thabs rgyu ni tshogs bsag dang*// de nyid sgom zhing bdag med bsgom pa ste// rgyu de med na nyon mongs 'bral mi 'gyur// de ma bral na de 'bras mi thob phyir// sems can sangs rgyas glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal sangs rgyas yin zhes ma pham pas// gsungs phyir de don de yin de ltar ro/

43 /bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med nam mkha' gnyis// 'dres na nyan thos dag gi mngon rtogs zhes// bsgom bya sems dang sgom byed kyang ni sems// gnyis med rdza bum chag pa'i nang nam mkha'// phyi yi mkha' dang dbye ba med pa lta'i// rtogs pa skyes tshe bla mar mos gus dang*// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel rtogs par gsol ba btab// gnad des zin na grol ba myur 'thob la// de med rgyun 'byams chad lta rbad khams can// deng sang rtogs ldan phal gyi nyams len 'dra/ 44 /rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa ni// gdams ngag zab ces gsungs pa 'di lta ste// las rlung sems kyi rta dang 'dra ba'i phyir// rlung la spros pa mang na sems 'tshub pas// rlung sems rang babs glod la don bsgom na// mchog 'grub 'on kyang man ngag zab mo'i gnad// gtum mo sum khrid dag tu shes par 'tshal/ 45 /mchog gi 'pho ba rnam shes bla ma ni// 'od gsal bya ba don la goms pa yi// gang zag mchog des rang gi rnam shes dang*// bla ma dag dang 'od gsal chos kyi sku// dbyer med rtogs pas chu la chu bzhag bzhin// 'pho bya 'pho byed 'pho yul gsum la sogs// kun rtog bral ba'i 'od gsal chos skur grol/ 46 /byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs sangs rgyas yin// gsungs pa mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i ngor sangs rgyas// byang chub sems kyi sku ru byon pa de// mtha' kun bral ba chos kyi sku nyid de// yon tan mdzad phrin rnams kyang mtha' dang bral// gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las kun la 'jug /rgyun chad mi mnga' rtag pa'i sku can no// de ltar
